articles.title: Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3, le PC portable pensé pour suivre toute la famille
articles.text:
Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3, le PC portable pensé pour suivre toute la famille
Avec son format fin de 17,9 mm et son poids contenu à 1,62 kg, le Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 vise un usage précis : accompagner aussi bien les révisions à la bibliothèque que le visionnage d'une série le soir venu, sans jamais peser lourd dans un sac. Il est actuellement disponible chez E.Leclerc.
Un format pensé pour circuler dans la maison comme à l'extérieur
À peine plus d'un kilo et demi : ce Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 se glisse dans un sac sans qu'on y pense vraiment, que ce soit au moment de partir en cours, ou pour l'emmener chez des amis le temps d'un weekend. Son écran de 15,6 pouces, traité contre les reflets, reste de son côté confortable qu'on l'utilise près d'une fenêtre en pleine journée ou allongé dans le canapé le soir venu. C'est le genre de détail qu'on ne remarque jamais tant qu'il fonctionne bien, et qu'on regrette amèrement sur un PC qui ne l'a pas. Et vous l’aurez compris : le but principal du Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3, c’est sa praticité.
Dans cette optique, la webcam intègre un petit cache à faire glisser d'un geste, pour couper l'objectif quand on n'en a pas besoin sans avoir à fouiller dans les réglages Windows. Une fois de plus, c’est un détail tout simple, mais qui rassure particulièrement quand plusieurs personnes se relaient sur le même ordinateur au fil de la semaine. En parallèle, le clavier et le pavé tactile ont été pensés pour tenir la distance sur de longues sessions, que ce soit pour rédiger un devoir ou enchaîner les épisodes d'une série un vendredi soir.
Découvrir le Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3
De quoi faire tourner les tâches quotidiennes sans jamais ramer
Sous le capot, vous trouverez ici un processeur AMD Ryzen 5 associé à 8 Go de mémoire vive, ce qui suffit largement à ce qu'on attend d'un PC familial : il s’agit ici de naviguer sur plusieurs onglets à la fois, de suivre un cours en visio pendant qu'un document reste ouvert à côté, ou de lancer une série en streaming sans que l'image ne se fige au pire moment. Le stockage de 512 Go laisse de son côté une vraie marge pour accumuler photos de vacances, documents scolaires et logiciels installés au fil du temps, sans devoir faire le ménage tous les deux mois.
Côté connectique, l'ordinateur embarque un port USB-C compatible transfert de données, charge et sortie vidéo DisplayPort, deux ports USB-A, une sortie HDMI pour brancher un second écran ou une TV, ainsi qu'un lecteur de cartes SD, pratique pour récupérer directement les photos d'un appareil photo. Le Wi-Fi 6 assure en parallèle une connexion stable même dans un foyer où plusieurs appareils sont connectés simultanément, en streaming, en visioconférence ou en téléchargement en tâche de fond.
Un confort pensé pour les longues soirées
Un détail mérite notre attention : l'écran limite la lumière bleue qu'il émet, ce qui sera particulièrement important lors d'une session de révisions tardive ou d'un épisode de trop avant de dormir. Par ailleurs, une puce de sécurité TPM 2.0 est activée en firmware, et c’est la même brique de sécurité que l'on retrouve sur des PC professionnels, pour chiffrer les données sensibles stockées sur la machine. Le PC est également conçu pour consommer sobrement et durer (via les certifications ENERGY STAR 9.0 et EPEAT Silver), ce point étant de plus en plus important dans le choix d'un appareil destiné à rester plusieurs années dans la maison.
Disponibilité et garantie
Le Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 est couvert par une garantie de 2 ans, avec prise en charge en atelier ou à domicile selon la nature de la panne, dont 1 an de couverture spécifique sur la batterie. Des extensions de garantie et une protection contre les dommages accidentels (chute, choc, liquide renversé) peuvent également être souscrites séparément pour prolonger la tranquillité d'esprit au-delà de la garantie de base, un argument qui parle particulièrement à un usage familial où l'appareil change régulièrement de mains.
Vous pouvez retrouver le Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 à cette adresse, chez E.Leclerc.

articles.title: ¿Se puede aprovechar el agua caliente de los océanos para generar electricidad? Un proyecto en Canarias quiere demostrar que sí
articles.text:
Nuestro planeta es una gigantesca fuente de energía. Aunque ya sabíamos que las olas de los mares tienen un gran potencial como energía renovable, un no tan novedoso método maremotérmico quiere utilizar la diferencia de temperatura entre la superficie y el fondo oceánico para generar electricidad de forma continua, las 24 horas del día.
Y parece que Canarias tiene todas las papeletas para beneficiarse de esta tecnología.
El océano tiene varias temperaturas. El Sol, al igual que en la costa, calienta la superficie del océano. En algunas zonas, especialmente en las zonas tropicales, la temperatura del agua más cercana a la superficie puede ser mucho más alta que la de las profundidades: según la estadounidense Energy Information Administration, este contraste térmico puede alcanzar los 20 ºC de diferencia.
El aprovechamiento de esta diferencia tiene el nombre de conversión de energía térmica oceánica (OTEC, por sus siglas en inglés) y no es una idea nueva como tal: como cuentan desde Infobae, hace ya 140 años que se explora el potencial que tiene el océano para proporcionar energía limpia. De acuerdo con lo que indicaba un informe de 2021 del National Laboratory of the Rockies que recoge El Periódico de la Energía, solo usando las aguas que rodean Estados Unidos, la OTEC podría satisfacer la demanda eléctrica de todo el país.
¿Cómo funciona la OTEC? Los sistemas OTEC buscan aprovechar esa diferencia de temperatura para generar electricidad mediante un ciclo continuo. El funcionamiento, a priori, parece sencillo: en primer lugar se recoge el agua caliente de la superficie del océano que está a unos 24 ºC para calentar y, en última instancia, evaporar un fluido de trabajo. Como la temperatura no es especialmente elevada, se suele emplear un fluido con un punto de ebullición bajo, como el amoniaco, según explica El Periódico de la Energía. Ese vapor que se produce se utiliza para girar una turbina y así generar electricidad.
En paralelo, se extrae agua de las profundidades del océano, de hasta unos 1.000 metros de profundidad, donde las temperaturas rondan los 4 ºC. Esta agua fría se usa para enfriar ese vapor de amoniaco y condensarlo para volver a repetir el ciclo indefinidamente.
Se está desarrollando en Canarias. Un ejemplo de esta tecnología se está probando actualmente en Canarias, donde la compañía británica Global OTEC está desplegando el primer sistema de este tipo en nuestro país, con la participación de la Plataforma Oceánica de Canarias (PLOCAN). El proyecto comenzó en 2022 y cuenta con el respaldo del programa Horizonte Europa de la Unión Europea, con una financiación de 3,5 millones de euros. Con estos fondos, se ha podido desarrollar el prototipo que se está testando: un casco cilíndrico flotante que, según cuenta Infobae, incorpora una tubería para captar el agua fría y un sistema de cardán para poder llevar a cabo este ciclo del agua marina.
Si se demuestra su viabilidad y su capacidad para funcionar con éxito en el mundo real, podría convertirse en una solución interesante para enclaves que, como las Islas Canarias, cuentan con un sistema energético fragmentado, una excesiva dependencia energética exterior y, más concretamente, una fuerte dependencia de los combustibles fósiles.

articles.title: Corsair Enters Fast Growing Mobile Recording Market with New Elgato Wireless Microphone
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 13th 2026
Corsair Enters Fast Growing Mobile Recording Market with New Elgato Wireless Microphone
Elgato, a Corsair brand, today introduced Wave Go, its first wireless microphone, extending its Wave audio lineup beyond the desktop to the fast growing mobile recording segment with a clip-on microphone and a handheld interview mic in one portable system. The global launch brings Elgato into a new growth category while connecting mobile creators to its existing audio software and Stream Deck controls.
Julian Fest, SVP and General Manager of Elgato"More content is being filmed on phones today than ever before, in more places and in ways that didn't exist a few years ago," "Wave Go was built for that world. One mic that handles it all, and sounds amazing the entire time."
Key Product Highlights
- Integrates with the Popular Elgato Ecosystem: Wave Link and Stream Deck integration connects mobile recording with desktop production.
- Two recording modes: Switch from a magnetic clip-on microphone to a handheld interview mic in seconds using the included Smart Handle.
- Lightweight design: The coin-sized transmitter weighs just 7 grams and attaches magnetically to clothing.
- Automatic audio processing: EQ Shift selects the sound profile for each mode. Auto Gain, a limiter, and a low-cut filter help manage voice levels and low-frequency rumble.
- Up to 48 hours of total runtime: The transmitter provides up to 8 hours per charge, and the Smart Handle stores up to five full recharges. A 10-minute charge provides about an hour of use.
- Simple phone recording: Connect through the USB-C receiver, with pass-through phone charging and on-device controls for recording, mute, and noise cancellation.
- Complete system for $99.99: Includes the transmitter, receiver, Smart Handle, carrying case, magnetic mounts, windscreens, and charging cable. A second transmitter costs $29.99 USD, or $14.99 USD when purchased with Wave Go on elgato.com.
- Broad launch reach: Direct availability in more than 40 countries and regions, with Corsair's authorized retail network to follow.
One Microphone for Mobile Recording and Interviews
Wave Go connects to a phone through a single USB-C receiver and switches between clip-on and handheld recording in seconds. The coin-sized transmitter weighs about 0.25 ounces and attaches magnetically to clothing. Its clip-on sound profile restores vocal clarity and presence when recording at chest level. For interviews, the transmitter slots into the Smart Handle to become a full-sized handheld microphone. The handle adds recording controls and charging, while a dedicated sound profile adjusts the microphone for the warmth and presence of close-up speech.
Automatic Audio Processing and Simple Controls
Wave Go combines a condenser capsule with onboard processing to deliver detailed voice recording without manual setup. EQ Shift automatically selects the sound profile for clip-on or handheld use. Auto Gain adjusts levels as voices get louder or quieter, while a limiter controls sudden peaks and a low-cut filter reduces low-frequency rumble. These features work automatically, without navigating menus or adjusting settings. A single button on the transmitter and Smart Handle controls power, mute, and recording on a connected phone. A button on the receiver switches noise cancellation on or off to reduce background noise. LEDs on all three components show operating status and battery level.
Up to 48 Hours of Runtime with Smart Handle Recharging
The transmitter delivers up to 8 hours of recording on a single charge. The Smart Handle stores up to five full recharges and charges the transmitter while it is docked, including during recording. Combined with the transmitter's initial charge, this provides up to 48 hours of total runtime. A 10-minute charge provides about an hour of use. The carrying case holds the transmitter, Smart Handle, receiver, and an optional second microphone. When connected to USB-C power, it recharges the system's components together. The receiver supports USB-C pass-through charging to keep a connected phone powered while recording.

articles.title: Un drone, une station automatisée et 25 secondes d’arrêt : DJI veut révolutionner les missions aériennes
articles.text:
Le constructeur chinois DJI vient de dévoiler le DJI Dock 4, une station automatisée pour drones. Sa particularité ? Ce dock est capable de remplacer la batterie d’un drone de façon autonome, en seulement 25 secondes. Pour être plus précis, le DJI Dock 4 supporte un drone spécifique : le Matrice 5TD. Celui-ci se révèle être un concentré de technologies qui, couplé au DJI Dock 4, promet d’amener de nouveaux standards dans le secteur des opérations aériennes continues. Il ne s’agit donc pas ici d’appareils grand public.
Un remplacement entièrement automatisé de la batterie du drone
Imaginez, le drone Matrice 5TD est en pleine mission, mais sa batterie est presque vide. Le drone rejoint la station DJI Dock 4 et celle-ci remplace la batterie de l’engin en 25 secondes, sans la moindre intervention humaine. Après un temps d’immobilisation de seulement 25 secondes, le drone peut repartir instantanément remplir sa mission. De son côté, le Matrice 5TD peut arriver sur un lieu à une vitesse pouvant atteindre 76 km/h et voler jusqu’à 59 minutes en continu. Vous l’aurez compris, le drone passe bien plus de temps dans les airs que sur le sol.
Le drone DJI Matrice 5TD intègre une multitude de technologies : un téléobjectif 11×, une caméra infrarouge, un télémètre laser et un système de vision nocturne en couleur avec des images en 4K, un radar à ondes millimétriques, un LiDAR ou encore une IA capable de détecter 17 types d’objets en temps réel (voitures, bateaux, animaux…). L’engin intègre ainsi une détection d’objets précise « même à l’intérieur d’un poste électrique rempli de matériel sous tension ou autour de lignes de distribution qui se croisent », selon DJI. Il parviendrait à éviter les lignes électriques, même la nuit.
La station Dock 4 résiste aux conditions météorologiques extrêmes
La station DJI Dock 4 peut fonctionner dans des conditions météorologiques extrêmes, avec des températures pouvant aller de −40 °C à 50 °C. Par temps froid, le dock préchauffe automatiquement les batteries. Par temps caniculaire, il active une climatisation. En cas de vents violents, la station ramène automatiquement le drone. Celui-ci peut par ailleurs décoller, atterrir et fonctionner dans des vents allant jusqu’à 43 km/h.
Avec sa station Dock 4, DJI apporte une partie de la réponse à l’un des principaux obstacles des drones : la nécessité de retourner au sol pour recharger ou remplacer leur batterie. Certes, une interruption de 25 secondes reste nécessaire pour changer de batterie, mais il s’agit tout de même d’une avancée significative. À terme, l’objectif des constructeurs serait de mettre au point des drones capables de voler en continu, sans jamais avoir besoin de se poser.

articles.title: Como escolher o melhor eSIM para ter internet móvel na sua Eurotrip • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Resumo
- A escolha do eSIM ideal para a Eurotrip depende de fatores como cobertura, volume de dados e tipo de serviço necessário.
- A Orange Travel oferece planos com cobertura em mais de 35 países europeus, incluindo opções com ligações e SMS ilimitados ou apenas dados para Internet, com preços a partir de R$ 88,49.
- Para contratar e ativar o eSIM, basta acessar o site ou app da Orange Travel, selecionar o plano ideal e seguir as instruções para ativá-lo no celular antes da viagem.
Escolher o melhor eSIM para viajar tranquila ou tranquilo pela Europa não precisa ser difícil. Além de garantir o conforto da sua viagem, ter um cartão eSIM disponível evita a necessidade de recorrer a redes Wi-Fi públicas, que podem representar um risco para os seus dados – e para sua viagem.
Existem diversas opções no mercado, assim como diferentes tipos de plano, ofertas de preço e mais. Ainda assim, é comum que o turista acabe gastando além do necessário para passar alguns dias viajando pelo Velho Continente. Da mesma forma, há quem economize além da conta e fique sem dados para mandar uma foto ou checar o mapa em tempo real para transitar pelas capitais europeias.
Para evitar gastos desnecessários e não prejudicar sua experiência na Europa, é importarnte entender como escolher o melhor eSIM para aproveitar a viagem. A seguir, tire dúvidas sobre o serviço e veja as melhores opções no mercado.
Meu eSIM vai funcionar na Inglaterra? E na Espanha?
A primeira pergunta a ser feita é: qual a cobertura que você precisa para sua Eurotrip? Uma das grandes vantagens de viajar pela Europa é conseguir conhecer diferentes culturas em poucos dias. Viagens de 14 são suficientes para conhecer três a quatro países diferentes, por exemplo, enquanto 30 dias de visita permitem ir além.
Em qualquer cenário, é importante contar com um eSIM que dê ampla cobertura para suas atividades turísticas, independente de quais destinos você pretende visitar. A Orange Travel é uma das empresas que garante conectividade em mais de 35 países pelo Velho Continente, oferecendo planos compatíveis com o tempo que você pretende passar por lá.
Se o seu plano de viagem inclui Londres, Paris, Barcelona, Madrid, Porto e Lisboa, por exemplo, é possível contratar seu eSIM com a partir de 10 GB de volume de dados, assim como planos completos, com ligações, SMS e 5G inclusos. Já para uma estadia maior e com mais detinos, passando também por Berlim, Amsterdam, Milão, Roma, Atenas, entre outras cidades históricas do continente, vale a pena buscar opções com pelo menos 30 dias e até 200 GB de conexão.
Da mesma forma, a Orange Travel também promete ser ideal para aquela Eurotrip mais voltada para o Leste Europeu, cobrindo destinos como Croácia, Romênia, Tchéquia, Eslováquia, Eslovênia e mais.

Plano com ligações e SMS ou só dados para Internet?
Uma decisão importante na hora de escolher o melhor eSIM para a sua Eurotrip é o tipo de serviço que você vai precisar por lá. Quem viaja em grupo, por exemplo, pode precisar fazer ligações locais ou trocar mensagens via SMS para encontrar amigos ou familiares sem gastar seu pacote de dados. Mas há quem prefira fazer tudo online e pagar menos por isso.
Os planos da Orange Travel funcionam para ambos os cenários, dando inclusive a possibiliade de usufruir do seu 5G sem limite de dados por até 30 dias de viagem. Quem precisar de mais tempo, pode renovar a assinatura pelo próprio serviço ou contratar planos de 45 ou 90 dias, com até 500 GB de internet para aproveitar sua viagem. Para as opções com ligações e SMS, não há limites para esses serviços.
Veja todos os planos oferecidos pela Orange Travel para ter seu eSIM durante a Eurotrip:

- Planos sem ligações e SMS (apenas 4G ou 5G)

Como contratar e ativar o eSIM no seu celular?
A contratação do eSIM pode ser feita diretamente no site ou no app da Orange Travel, disponível tanto no Android quanto no iOS. Basta acessar o serviço, selecionar o plano ideal para a sua viagem e finalizar a compra. Não esqueça de checar se seu celular é compatível com a tecnologia buscando “eSIM” no app de Configurações ou Ajustes, caso você use um iPhone.
Uma vez com o plano contratado, siga o passo a passo oferecido pela Orange Travel para ativar. Você pode alternar entre o seu chip brasileiro e o eSIM europeu diretamente nas configurações do celular. É importante realizar o passo a passo antes de embarcar para a sua viagem.
Por que ter um eSIM durante sua Eurotrip?
O uso de um eSIM local durante viagens é uma prática comum em todo o mundo. Para evitar a ativação de roaming em sua operadora no Brasil, o que pode sair mais caro em relação à compra de um chip específico para usar na viagem, a assinatura de um plano virtual é a melhor opção.
Com preços mais acessíveis e limites de uso ajustáveis à sua necessidade, é possível aproveitar ao máximo seu tempo na Europa, independente dos destinos que você vai visitar durante a viagem. Além disso, a alternativa de contratar planos com chamadas e mensagens ilimitadas representa um meio a mais de se comunicar com a sua família e amigos no Brasil ou mesmo com o grupo que viajará com você para o Velho Continente.
Outra vantagem é a praticidade de uso: caso você precise de mais dados de Internet ou mesmo ativar um plano com ligações e mensagens, basta recarregar seu eSIM ou escolher a melhor opção diretamente no aplicativo ou no site da Orange Travel.
Depois da viagem, não precisa se preocupar: o eSIM funcionará apenas pelo tempo contratado. Na sua próxima visita à Europa, basta entrar no app da Orange Travel para escolher seu novo plano e reativá-lo.

articles.title: Terafab will reportedly receive its first ASML EUV tool in mid-2027
articles.text:
Elon Musk's Terafab will reportedly receive its first EUV tool from ASML in mid-2027 — cutting-edge scanner could sit idle for some time as experimental facility is completed
Despite Musk's boosting of FEL light sources, traditional EUV will inscribe chips for now
Elon Musk's Terafab will get its first EUV lithography tool in the middle of next year, reports Tim Culpan, citing sources with knowledge of the matter. But considering that the shell of the firm's development fab will not be completed until late 2027 and that tools will only begin to be moved in later that year, according to SemiAnalysis, the scanner will sit idle for some time.
Tesla broke ground on its research fab on the north campus of Giga Texas near Austin this past April. SemiAnalysis expects the building to be completed in 15 months and predicts it will take Tesla a further six months to install equipment and production tools, after which it will be able to start processing wafers, or rather experimenting with chip production to get the team prepared for completion of the Terafab volume fab phase 1.
Given how hard it is to get an ASML Twinscan NXE EUV lithography tool these days, storing it for several months before putting it to use may sound like an expensive slack period, but it's not the significant financial problem for Terafab that it would be for a traditional chipmaker.
The projected delivery of a conventional EUV lithography system to Terafab also indicates that while Elon Musk has praised free electron laser (FEL) light sources for lithography tools, the first-generation efforts of his semiconductor production company will rely on more traditional equipment. This is not particularly surprising, as Terafab is set to use Intel's 14A manufacturing technology. 14A will use not only existing Low-NA EUV scanners, but also next-generation High-NA EUV machines.
Using lithography systems with unconventional and largely untested light sources would require substantial modifications to the manufacturing process, extensive equipment qualification, and potentially changes to photomasks and photoresists, which would complicate the transfer of Intel’s 14A technology and delay Terafab's production ramp.
But usage of standard lithography equipment does not mean that Musk's company has no plans to use tools that are different from those used by Intel, though for now it is too early to make guesses about what Terafab engineers might change in terms of fab configuration.
SpaceX announced that it had selected Grimes County for Terafab in early August 2026. By now, there is evidence that work has progressed beyond clearing land, as drone footage published by Joe Tegtmeyer in mid-September showed foundation excavation and rebar cage installation at the northwestern part of the site. This suggests that contractors had begun structural construction by early September, although the precise purpose of the foundation is unknown.
Get Tom's Hardware's best news and in-depth reviews, straight to your inbox.
Right now, SemiAnalysis reports that project Terafab Grimes phase 1 will be built in 20 months, equipped in 17 months, and ramped to volume in six months. Analysts project that the fab will begin operation in late 2029 and then ramped to volume by mid-2030.
An interesting note about Terafab's volume fab is that SpaceX reportedly ordered semiconductor manufacturing equipment in April 2026, several months before officially announcing the Grimes County location. This indicates that the company committed to its manufacturing plans well before the public groundbreaking. In addition, this makes the mid-2028 equipment installation forecast plausible, given the long lead times associated with advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
Intel plans to begin risk production using its 14A (1.4nm-class) fabrication process in the second half of 2027 and initiate high-volume manufacturing (HVM) in the second half of 2028 if everything goes as planned. This puts Intel's ramp into HVM at least 1.5 years ahead of SpaceX’s Terafab Grimes Phase 1.
This means that while Terafab will get a proven advanced manufacturing technology, presumably with decent yields, it will not be the absolute best production node at the time, as TSMC intends to start volume production of chips using its A12 fabrication process in late 2029. A12 is a 1.2nm-class process with TSMC's second-generation nanosheet GAA transistors and backside power delivery. Intel will be close to unveiling its 14A-P node at the same time.
Nonetheless, since Terafab will likely exclusively serve SpaceX, Tesla, and xAI, a slightly less advanced node will not be a big problem for the company, as the potential cost increases incurred by using a more sophisticated manufacturing technology will be offset by using an in-house production facility.

Anton Shilov is a contributing writer at Tom’s Hardware. Over the past couple of decades, he has covered everything from CPUs and GPUs to supercomputers and from modern process technologies and latest fab tools to high-tech industry trends.

articles.title: Steam ofrece 4 contenidos descargables gratis en PC por tiempo limitado: cuáles son
articles.text:
Steam ofrece cuatro contenidos descargables gratuitos para PC por tiempo limitado. Las promociones incluyen Voidtrain - Big Catch, Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Gear.Club Signature Pack, Rotwood: Drakin Armoury Pack y MXGP 26 - Scrubdesignz Liveries.
Los cuatro artículos se añaden sin costo a la biblioteca de Steam, aunque no son juegos completos: se trata de contenidos adicionales que requieren contar con los títulos base para poder utilizarlos. Las fechas límite varían según cada promoción.
MXGP 26 - Scrubdesignz Liveries estará disponible hasta el 15 de octubre, mientras que Voidtrain - Big Catch podrá reclamarse hasta el 19 de octubre.
Por su parte, Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Gear.Club Signature Pack seguirá gratis hasta el 22 de octubre. La promoción de Rotwood: Drakin Armoury Pack también finaliza el 15 de octubre.
Cómo acceder a los contenidos gratuitos
Para sumar los paquetes a la cuenta, los usuarios deben ingresar a la tienda de Steam, iniciar sesión y buscar cada uno de los contenidos incluidos en la promoción.
Allí deberán seleccionar la opción para obtenerlos sin costo antes de que venza el plazo correspondiente.
Una vez reclamados, los paquetes quedarán asociados a la biblioteca del usuario. Sin embargo, será necesario tener instalado o adquirir el juego base de cada uno para acceder a sus funciones y objetos adicionales.
Las promociones están identificadas como “Free to Keep”, una modalidad que permite conservar el contenido en la cuenta después de añadirlo durante el período gratuito.
De qué tratan los contenidos gratuitos de Steam
Voidtrain - Big Catch incorpora una actividad de pesca en el universo del juego. Los jugadores pueden capturar especies, obtener escamas, mejorar la caña y el carrete, y usar los recursos conseguidos para desbloquear decoraciones destinadas al tren.
El paquete Gear.Club Unlimited 3 - Gear.Club Signature Pack suma contenido adicional para el juego de conducción desarrollado por Eden Games y publicado por Nacon.
Por último, MXGP 26 - Scrubdesignz Liveries añade nuevos diseños para las motos de MXGP 26 - The Official Game, mientras que Rotwood: Drakin Armoury Pack ofrece un paquete promocional de objetos para el título de acción cooperativa.
Steam bate un récord con 720 lanzamientos en una semana, pero la mayoría pasa desapercibida
Steam alcanzó un récord de 720 lanzamientos entre el 24 y el 30 de agosto, un promedio de 102 juegos diarios o más de cuatro por hora.
La cifra refleja el crecimiento sostenido de la plataforma y la facilidad con la que los desarrolladores pueden publicar sus proyectos ante una audiencia global, sin depender de intermediarios tradicionales.
Sin embargo, el aumento de la oferta también profundiza un problema central: la visibilidad. Según datos recopilados por ICO Partners, 530 de los 720 juegos lanzados durante esa semana recibieron entre cero y nueve reseñas, mientras que solo 10 superaron las 1.000 calificaciones de usuarios.
La diferencia expone la dificultad que enfrentan los estudios independientes para destacar dentro de un catálogo cada vez más extenso.
Thomas Bidaux, director ejecutivo de ICO Partners, había anticipado que Steam superaría la marca de 700 estrenos semanales.
El crecimiento fue acelerado: en 2013, la plataforma registró 436 lanzamientos en todo el año; en 2024 superó los 19.000 juegos publicados y en 2025 sumó cerca de 21.000. Durante la primera mitad de 2026, ya acumulaba aproximadamente 12.000 títulos.
Publicar un juego en Steam ya no garantiza llegar a los jugadores. La atención depende de las recomendaciones de la plataforma, las reseñas, las redes sociales y la cobertura de medios especializados.
Sin campañas de promoción o una comunidad previa, muchos proyectos quedan relegados de las búsquedas y pasan inadvertidos.
Aunque existen excepciones como Peak, Schedule 1, Balatro y Megabonk, que lograron consolidarse sin grandes anuncios iniciales, esos casos no representan la experiencia habitual. De hecho, alrededor del 80% de los juegos estrenados en 2024 no registró jugadores.
La tienda también incorporó propuestas gratuitas de simulación, terror, fantasía y narrativa, pero el crecimiento del catálogo mantiene el mismo desafío: entre miles de opciones, encontrar una audiencia se volvió tan difícil como desarrollar un juego.

For me, the expression, along with the next line “I smell the blood of an Englishman”, is a strong reminder of being a small child, when all adults seemed like giants, as it is what my uncle would bellow at the start of a hide-and-seek game.

What is NYT Connections?
NYT Connections is one of several increasingly popular word games made by the New York Times. It challenges you to find groups of four items that share something in common, and each group has a different difficulty level: green is easy, yellow a little harder, blue often quite tough and purple usually very difficult.
On the plus side, you don't technically need to solve the final one, as you'll be able to answer that one by a process of elimination. What's more, you can make up to four mistakes, which gives you a little bit of breathing room.
It's a little more involved than something like Wordle, however, and there are plenty of opportunities for the game to trip you up with tricks. For instance, watch out for homophones and other word games that could disguise the answers.
It's playable for free via the NYT Games site on desktop or mobile.

articles.title: Global 300mm Fab Equipment Spending to Reach $227 Billion in 2029 as Buildout Accelerates
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 13th 2026
Global 300mm Fab Equipment Spending to Reach $227 Billion in 2029 as Buildout Accelerates
Global 300 mm front-end fab equipment spending is projected to reach $149 billion in 2026, up 31% year-over-year, SEMI reported today in its latest 300 mm Fab Outlook. Investment is expected to continue growing at double-digit rates through 2029, reaching $227 billion. The stronger investment trajectory is accompanied by a sustained pipeline of new 300 mm fabs and production lines moving through construction and into operation. Excluding pure R&D fabs, SEMI projects 20 new 300 mm fabs or lines to begin construction worldwide in 2026 and 18 in 2027. In the United States, three are projected to begin construction in 2026 and four in 2027.
Ajit Manocha, SEMI President and CEO"Semiconductor demand is increasingly translating into physical manufacturing expansion across the global industry," "The latest outlook points to both stronger equipment investment and a substantial pipeline of fabs moving toward operation. This expansion will provide the manufacturing foundation needed to support AI, high-performance computing and a broad range of next-generation semiconductor applications."
Global Fab Construction Pipeline
Across all 300 mm facilities, global fab construction spending is projected to rise 23% to $47.5 billion in 2026 and another 33% to $63.3 billion in 2027, before reaching $68.4 billion in 2028. The construction activity reflects continued investment in new manufacturing capacity across leading-edge logic, memory and other 300 mm semiconductor technologies.
The U.S. represents an important part of this expansion, with additional 300 mm fabs and lines expected to begin construction throughout the forecast period. Equipment investment in the Americas is projected to more than double from $18.1 billion in 2026 to $40.6 billion in 2029, reflecting the region's expanding manufacturing footprint.
SEMI projects 13 new 300 mm fabs or lines worldwide to begin operations or ship first silicon in 2026, increasing to 23 in 2027.
The 3Q26 edition of the SEMI 300 mm Fab Outlook reflects 166 changes across 163 fabs and lines, including 14 newly added records, since the previous report.

Uvi raises $7.5M to help AI agents learn business context and run at eight times lower cost - SiliconANGLE
articles.text:
Uvi raises $7.5M to help AI agents learn business context and run at eight times lower cost
Agentic artificial intelligence startup Uvi said today it has raised $7.5 million in seed funding to tackle an expensive problem around business context that’s draining millions of dollars annually from the coffers of enterprises using autonomous AI agents.
It’s backed by CT Innovations, which led the round, alongside Cardumen, Mana VC and 91 Ventures, which joined as participating investors.
Each time a new AI agent is deployed, it knows nothing at all about the company that deployed it. Those agents have to learn everything about the company’s business processes and operations from scratch in a process that’s repeated again and again, racking up significant costs in terms of computing resources.
Business context is crucial to agentic operations. If an AI agent is going to be able to work autonomously for an organization without constant human oversight, it needs to be well versed in the way that company operates.
That means knowledge of its operations, its historical decisions and so on. Until now, the only way agents could obtain this context was to reconstruct it from scratch with each new deployment, and that in turn means paying the model provider for each token used in that relearning process.
Uvi, officially known as Naboo Research Ltd., says enterprises are losing a fortune to this inefficiency. Data from its own benchmark tests shows that internally built AI agents cost the average company about eight times more than they should because of the need to repeatedly gather all of this context before they can get started at work. It’s disadvantageous in terms of speed, too, said Uvi co-founder and Chief Executive Gilad Salinger.
Salinger told SiliconANGLE that the problem is getting bigger the more AI adoption increases. He stressed that in the early days of AI agents, most companies were worried about the accuracy of their responses and the security of the actions they take. But now the conversation has turned towards cost, tokens and speed, where agents continue to struggle.
“The reason is structural, not about intelligence,” Salinger said. “Big companies run dozens of different tools with completely different data shapes, and the ability to pull two slices of data in parallel, say one from Snowflake and another from GitHub, and then reason over that data does not exist for them. So even when an agent has already completed a task, it would fail the same task the next time, because it never retained how the work actually gets done.”
Context is everything
Uvi believes it has hit upon a solution, developiing what Salinger calls a “context reasoning layer” that each company owns. Instead of having each new agent relearn the way the business operates, they can simply tap into this unified institutional memory that’s made available to every AI tool within its information technology environment.
Uvi supplies this context by linking fragmented enterprise systems such as Slack, Jira, Confluence, Salesforce and so on with other data from code repositories and the minutes of internal meetings. It then builds a map that shows how all of this information is linked, building a full picture of why each decision was made, what the decision was and its impact on the company.
This context reasoning layer is built atop knowledge graph that functions as an infrastructure layer, sitting underneath every AI agent that’s deployed by a company. It uses entity mapping to understand the organization’s engineering stack, track its dependencies and how different assets within it relate to one another.
Uvi also analyzes historical context, such as a decision that was made in Slack that was later reversed inside a comment in a document, to reconstruct agent’s reasoning processes. In addition, Uvi has developed a custom semantic layer for the knowledge graph to help AI agents learn the specific company jargon they’re going to come across, ensuring they can interpret terms accurately.
More importantly, Uvi’s context reasoning layer is secure by design. Knowing that knowledge graphs often struggle when it comes to things like user permissions, the company built an access control model that controls access at the application and administration layers, and also uses data tagging.
“We tag data so that a person who leaves a tool, or leaves the company, cannot be surfaced by agents down the road,” Salinger explained. “This is the part most RAG pipelines get wrong. They ingest once and forget who was allowed to see what. Our graph reconstructs relationships across platforms and carries the permissions with it, so there’s no need for a separate security retrofit.
Uvi’s benchmarks reveal huge cost benefits for companies willing to adopt its context reasoning layer. Agents that run without it can cost between $0.75 and $1.41 per response, and in some cases can even exceed $2, Salinger said. But when those agents route their responses through Uvi, the costs fall dramatically, to an average of just 10 to 16 cents per answer.
The cost savings are even more dramatic with open-ended questions, where agents often get themselves stuck in a recurring search loop, relearning the same bit of context again and again to try and respond to a single prompt. In such scenarios, Uvi agents cost 46 times less than their non-Uvi counterparts, while answering questions twice as fast.
Uvi has already convinced Monday.com Inc., Lemonade Inc. and Melio of the merits of its platform. In the case of Monday.com, Uvi helps its agents understand the relationships among Jira tickets, pull requests and feature flags. Without this contextual understanding, agents often retrieve a disjointed list of tickets, Salinger said, forcing workers to manually sort through them to find the answers they need. By tracing the relationships of those tickets, Uvi can dig up the answers much faster.
This is why CT Innovation’s Gwen Cheni is convinced that Uvi is onto something good. She said virtually every company she talks to about AI agents has struggled to build context at scale. “Most are still very far away,” she added. “Uvi is the finished version of a project they have already paid for multiple times over.”
Salinger said he believes that every AI agent will eventually need a context layer to tap into, because there’s simply no other way to do it without sacrificing efficiency.
“In three years, the enterprise AI stack will not be organized around chat interfaces or document search,” he said. “It will be organized around a persistent context layer that every agent, every model and every identity plugs into. Companies that have this content will ship new agents the way they ship with continuous integration/continuous development pipelines today, while those that don’t will be forced to keep paying their models to relearn their business every morning.”

articles.title: L'IA va-t-elle faire grimper la facture d'électricité en Europe ?
articles.text:
Les datacenters pourraient consommer jusqu'à 17% de l'électricité aux Pays-Bas et 30% en Irlande en 2035. Construire les centrales et les lignes nécessaires coûtera cher, et la note pourrait se retrouver sur les factures.
En 2025, les datacenters représentaient environ 2,5% de l'électricité consommée dans la plupart des grands marchés européens. Selon une étude de Moody's, rapportée par The Register, cette part pourrait grimper dans plusieurs pays du Vieux Continent d'ici 2035.
Qui paiera les centrales et les lignes que réclament les datacenters ?
La France et le Royaume-Uni devraient atteindre au moins 5,7% de la demande d'électricité en 2035. L'Irlande est un cas à part : la part y est passée de 5% en 2015 à 23% en 2025. Nous rapportions en juillet 2024 que les datacenters irlandais absorbaient déjà 21% du courant du pays en 2023, soit plus que les foyers urbains (18%). Or, pour rester compétitive, l'Union européenne veut plus que tripler sa capacité en datacenters d'ici cinq à sept ans, avec des sites dans les pays nordiques et le sud du continent. Il faudra donc produire plus d'électricité et agrandir les réseaux.
Cette stratégie pèsera tout d'abord sur les gestionnaires de réseaux. Selon les analystes, ils auront une pression à court terme sur leurs comptes, aggravée par le retard avec lequel de nombreux régimes de régulation leur remboursent ces investissements. Cette pression est plus forte pour les réseaux de transport (les lignes à haute tension qui acheminent le courant sur de longues distances) que pour la distribution (les lignes locales), car les exploitants de datacenters ne financent que leur propre raccordement. Certains électriciens installent des datacenters sur d'anciens sites de centrales fossiles, déjà reliés au réseau. D'autres s'associent à des promoteurs pour construire et alimenter de nouveaux sites.
Ces dépenses, ajoutées aux déséquilibres entre offre et demande, devraient faire monter les prix de l'énergie. Par le passé, les pouvoirs publics ont alors limité la charge pour les consommateurs. Certains gouvernements étudient déjà des baisses d'impôts et des aides aux utilisateurs. De plus en plus de gestionnaires de réseaux de transport exigent des garanties financières pour écarter les projets spéculatifs ou en double, une piste que Londres examine. Les mesures pourraient se durcir avec un plafonnement du prix de l'électricité, des taxes ou des prélèvements supplémentaires.
L'Irlande et les États-Unis ont déjà réagi. Le régulateur irlandais (la CRU) a remplacé son moratoire sur les nouveaux raccordements par des règles. Tout projet de 10 MVA ou plus (mégavoltampère) doit fournir, sur place ou à proximité, une capacité de production ou de stockage équivalente, et couvrir au moins 80% de sa consommation annuelle avec des projets renouvelables supplémentaires dans le pays. Outre-Atlantique, la Ratepayer Protection Pledge, lancée par le président Trump pour calmer le mécontentement des électeurs, engage électriciens, promoteurs et États à ne pas répercuter sur les citoyens le coût de l'énergie et des réseaux supplémentaires. Moody's s'attend à ce que d'autres gouvernements européens suivent si le rythme actuel se maintient. Dans le cas contraire, la facture d'électricité pourrait augmenter du côté des consommateurs.

articles.title: Google ofrecerá 15.000 becas en Colombia con certificado profesional en IA y mercadeo
articles.text:
El Gobierno de Colombia y Google anunciaron una alianza para llevar inteligencia artificial, formación y herramientas educativas a estudiantes, docentes y trabajadores del país, con prioridad para las zonas afectadas por el terremoto de agosto de 2026. El vicepresidente, José Manuel Restrepo, dijo que el plan busca vincular la tecnología con oportunidades de formación y empleo, en especial para jóvenes que no estudian ni trabajan.
La iniciativa contempla una plataforma de capacitación administrada por el SENA con alcance potencial para un millón de personas, mediante rutas de aprendizaje en inteligencia artificial, computación en la nube, analítica de datos y ciberseguridad. El programa se integrará a Google Career Launchpad, destinado a docentes y estudiantes.
Restrepo afirmó que el acuerdo reúne becas, licencias educativas y formación profesional bajo el eje ColombIA. “Con Google damos el primer gran paso de Talento ColombIA para convertir la inteligencia artificial y las nuevas tecnologías en oportunidades de formación y empleo, especialmente para los jóvenes que ni estudian ni trabajan”.
por su parte, Edgardo Frías, director general de Google para la Región Andina, definió el acuerdo como una estrategia centrada en el acceso a herramientas y formación. “La tecnología y la formación muestran que la IA no es una promesa: sino una realidad en manos de los jóvenes, los docentes y los estudiantes de todas las edades”.
El plan prevé 15.000 becas y 7 millones de licencias para el sector público
Google y el Ministerio de TIC entregarán 15.000 becas para los Certificados de Carrera de Google, que se harán en Coursera. La ONG Colnodo distribuirá los cupos y priorizará las inscripciones de Chocó, Buenaventura, Cali, Pereira, Manizales y Armenia.
Cada beca permite acceder durante un año a la plataforma y tener el Certificado Profesional de IA de Google, compuesto por ocho módulos. El contenido incluye nociones básicas de inteligencia artificial, investigación, escritura, creación de contenidos, análisis de datos, desarrollo de aplicaciones e implementación de soluciones.
Los beneficiarios también podrán elegir entre siete certificados en español en soporte de TI, márketing digital, ciberseguridad, análisis de datos, gestión de proyectos y diseño de experiencia de usuario. Los requisitos son ser mayor de 18 años de edad, residir en Colombia y contar con conexión a internet y computador; no se exige experiencia previa ni título universitario.
Las postulaciones ya están disponibles en el sitio web de Colnodo hasta agotar los cupos. La organización comenzará a notificar el estado de las solicitudes el 26 de octubre de 2026.
Julián Casasbuenas, director de Colnodo, se refirió a la orientación territorial de la convocatoria. “Nos emociona que las oportunidades lleguen sobre todo a impactar a las personas en las zonas afectadas por el terremoto de agosto, una oportunidad para que más colombianos puedan aprender a utilizar y aprovechar herramientas de inteligencia artificial”.
Google indicó que más de 13.500 colombianos ya obtuvieron una certificación de sus programas de carrera: el 70% de los graduados informó efectos positivos, como aumentos salariales, nuevos empleos o ascensos, durante los primeros seis meses tras finalizar sus estudios.
Las licencias comenzarán a habilitarse en Chocó y Buenaventura
El Ministerio de Educación prevé habilitar hasta 7 millones de licencias activas durante los próximos cuatro años para estudiantes, docentes, rectores y personal administrativo de instituciones públicas. La primera fase comenzará durante el trimestre en Chocó y Buenaventura.
Los equipos educativos recibirán formación para usar Google Workspace for Education Fundamentals, una herramienta de colaboración y almacenamiento de información en la nube. El programa incluirá capacitación técnica y pedagógica, con un esquema en el que Google formará a un equipo designado por el Ministerio, que luego acompañará a los maestros en ciudadanía digital, educación híbrida y uso de inteligencia artificial en el aula.

articles.title: Notebook com 32 GB de RAM: 7 modelos para comprar em 2026 • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Notebook com 32 GB de RAM: 7 modelos para comprar em 2026
Encontre os melhores notebooks com 32 GB de memória RAM de fábrica para ótima fluidez e agilidade em multitarefa
Notebooks com 32 GB de RAM são ideais para quem costuma usar vários apps ao mesmo tempo, já que conseguem manter mais dados temporários.
Vale priorizar memórias RAM com padrões mais recentes e taxas de transferência mais rápidas, mas também é preciso analisar aspectos como processador, tela e autonomia de bateria.
Para te ajudar na escolha, o Tecnoblog lista sete opções de notebook com 32 GB de RAM para evitar travamentos em multitarefas. Confira modelos da Asus, Samsung, Acer, Lenovo e Vaio.
O Asus Vivobook S 14 é uma ótima opção de notebook para multitarefas e produtividade. Ele combina o processador Intel Core Ultra 7 258V (8 núcleos e 8 threads) com 32 GB de RAM (LPDDR5X), e ainda traz SSD de 1 TB para armazenar arquivos e programas com sobra.
A tela OLED de 14″ entrega cores mais vivas e contrastes mais profundos, embora apresente taxa de atualização limitada a 60 Hz. O display também oferece resolução WUXGA (1920 x 1200 pixels).
O notebook pesa apenas 1,3 kg mesmo com construção em metal e ainda traz uma bateria de 75 Wh com autonomia de até 27 horas. Durabilidade militar MIL-STD-810H e tecnologia térmica Asus IceCool completam os destaques do laptop.
O Asus ROG Strix G16 é um notebook gamer para jogos e tarefas exigentes, com processador Intel Core i9 14900HX (24 núcleos e 32 threads) e 32 GB de RAM (DDR5). Ele também conta com a placa RTX 5070 (8 GB) para processamento gráfico e SSD NVMe de 1 TB.
Apesar de não ter construção OLED, a tela IPS de 16 polegadas tem resolução 2.5K (2560 x 1600) e taxa de atualização de 240 Hz. Isso garante mais fluidez em jogos, especialmente em games FPS (First-Person Shooter).
A bateria tem capacidade de 8.100 mAh e a caixa do produto acompanha uma fonte de 280 W para as recargas. O peso de 2,6 kg é um dos pontos negativos, e pode dificultar a portabilidade.
O Galaxy Book 6 oferece alto desempenho para as tarefas do dia a dia. Ele é alimentado pelo chip Intel Core Ultra 7 355 de 8 núcleos e 8 threads, aliado a 32 GB de RAM LPDDR5X e SSD NVMe de 1 TB.
A tela IPS de 14″ é mais compacta que a de concorrentes, mas tem resolução de 1920 x 1200 pixels e acabamento antirreflexo. A taxa de atualização do display fica em 60 Hz, que é um padrão mais básico e menos fluido que telas de 120 Hz ou mais.
O notebook traz um design leve (1,43 kg) e fino (14,9 mm de espessura) e ainda conta com uma bateria íon-lítio de 61 Wh com autonomia de até 24 horas.
O Acer Nitro V15 é um notebook ideal para gamers iniciantes ou casuais. O laptop é mais modesto que o Asus ROG Strix G16, mas chega com processador AMD Ryzen 7 7735HS (8 núcleos e 16 threads), 32 GB de RAM (DDR5) e SSD de 512 GB. A GPU dedicada fica na conta da RTX 4060 com 6 GB de VRAM.
A tela tem 15,6 polegadas, com resolução Full HD (1920 x 1080 pixels) e taxa de atualização de 165 Hz para gameplays mais fluidas. Contudo, a cobertura de 45% NTSC limita a reprodução de cores no display.
Pesando 2,1 kg, o notebook inclui uma bateria de 57 Wh que pode durar até 5 horas. Também há um sistema de refrigeração com duas ventoinhas para estabilizar a temperatura do aparelho.
O Lenovo ThinkBook 14 Gen 6 é voltado para usos básicos e moderados, com boa performance para multitarefas. As especificações incluem o chip i7-13700H (14 núcleos e 20 threads), 32 GB de RAM (DDR5) e SSD é de 256 GB.
A tela compacta de 14″ oferece resolução WUXGA e taxa de atualização de 60 Hz. Mas assim como o Acer Nitro V15, o display do Lenovo ThinkBook 14 Gen 6 tem cobertura de cor 45% NTSC e não é indicado para quem trabalha com edições de imagem.
Já a bateria tem 60 Wh de capacidade e é compatível com carregamento rápido. O aparelho também é leve, pesando apenas 1,38 kg.
O Vaio FE16 é um notebook intermediário para estudos, trabalho e uso pessoal. O dispositivo chega com chip AMD Ryzen 5-5625U (6 núcleos e 12 threads) e um SSD NVMe de 512 GB. São 32 GB de RAM para otimizar o desempenho multitarefas, apesar do padrão DDR4 mais antigo.
A tela de 16″ não é das mais fluidas, já que a taxa de atualização é de 60 Hz. Em compensação, o display tem acabamento antirreflexo e resolução WUXGA, superior ao Full HD.
O aparelho pesa 1,85 kg e ainda inclui uma bateria de 55 Wh com autonomia máxima de 10 horas.
O Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 é um notebook intermediário para quem busca boa performance em tarefas cotidianas, produtividade moderada e costuma navegar com várias guias abertas. Afinal, são 32 GB de RAM que acompanham o processador Intel Core 7 350 (6 núcleos e 6 threads). Também há um SSD de 512 GB para armazenamento local.
O display de LCD tem 15,3 polegadas com resolução WUXGA e tecnologia antirreflexo para otimizar a visibilidade. Já a taxa de atualização da tela é de 60 Hz, que é um padrão mais simples.
O aparelho pesa 1,59 kg e conta com uma bateria de 65 Wh de capacidade.
A escolha pelo melhor notebook com 32 GB de RAM deve considerar as especificações dos pentes de memória. Fique de olho em:
Além disso, não esqueça de optar por modelos com processadores mais rápidos, telas mais fluidas e com resoluções maiores, e baterias de boa autonomia. Essas especificações também são importantes para diferenciar modelos equivalentes.
O Samsung Galaxy Book 6 é o notebook com melhor custo-benefício da lista. O aparelho chega com 32 GB de RAM (LPDDR5X) e SSD de 1 TB para armazenar fotos e arquivos. Além disso, o laptop pesa apenas 1,4 kg e tem autonomia de até 24 horas de uso.
O Vaio FE16 é uma alternativa ainda mais barata, com processador AMD Ryzen 5-5625U, resolução de tela WUXGA e 32 GB de RAM. O único ponto é que ele usa o padrão de RAM DDR4, que oferece taxas de transferência mais baixas em comparação ao padrão DDR5.
Não. Um notebook com 32 GB de RAM oferece fluidez e confiabilidade de uso para quem está acostumado a usar vários aplicativos (incluindo softwares mais exigentes) e abas ao mesmo tempo.
E ainda que você não use todo o limite de RAM, o sistema operacional pode aproveitar a RAM livre como cache para acelerar o acesso a dados e arquivos recentes. Ou seja, a RAM excedente não é desperdiçada.
Um notebook com 16 GB RAM é recomendado para a maioria dos usuários comuns, oferecendo margem segura para multitarefas como navegar com várias abas abertas, pastas do sistema operacional e programas moderados.
Já notebooks com 32 GB de RAM são ideais para multitarefas com cargas de trabalho mais intensas. Esses aparelhos conseguem armazenar mais dados na RAM ao mesmo tempo, incluindo softwares pesados de edição de vídeo ou mesmo jogos.
Sim, desde que o notebook suporte upgrade de RAM de 32 GB. Não basta apenas verificar se a memória RAM é expansível: você deve certificar que o laptop é compatível com 32 GB ou mais, já que os limites máximos suportados podem variar.

articles.title: One UI 9 (Android 17) débarque sur les Samsung Galaxy S23
articles.text:
Quelques jours seulement après les Galaxy S24, le constructeur coréen déploie son interface One UI 9, basée sur Android 17, sur ses Samsung Galaxy plus anciens, à savoir les Galaxy S23. Le marché européen n’est pas le premier servi, mais cela ne devrait plus tarder.
Un déploiement progressif pour les anciens flagships
La version stable de One UI 9 arrive tout juste sur les Samsung Galaxy S23. Pour le moment, l’accès à la dernière version de l’OS est réservé aux utilisateurs de la version bêta sur ces téléphones, et en Corée du Sud. Comme toujours, le pays d’origine de la marque sert de rampe de lancement, donnant ainsi le top départ pour le déploiement mondial.
Le reste des utilisateurs situés dans d’autres régions du monde devrait donc voir arriver la mise à jour d’ici une à deux semaines, si l’on se base sur le rythme observé pour les autres appareils de la marque. Du côté de la documentation officielle, les notes de version pour la variante coréenne du Galaxy S23 n’ont pas encore été actualisées. Il est donc encore difficile de savoir si les téléphones intègrent l’intégralité des nouveautés liées à l’intelligence artificielle ou s’il s’agit simplement d’une refonte visuelle par rapport à One UI 8.5.
À lire : Quels smartphones Samsung vont recevoir les nouveautés Galaxy IA de One UI 9 ?
Poursuite du calendrier de mise à jour chez Samsung
Les smartphones haut de gamme de Samsung ne sont pas les seuls concernés puisque certains smartphones milieu de gamme de la série A ont également déjà profité de la mise à jour de One UI 9. Si l’attente est toujours trop longue pour les utilisateurs, on peut au moins accorder à Samsung le fait que le suivi logiciel de ses smartphones est parmi les meilleurs sur Android.
Si vous avez un Galaxy S23, vous n’avez rien de particulier à faire si ce n’est d’attendre une notification sur votre smartphone vous indiquant que la mise à jour est disponible. Vous pouvez également regarder manuellement si une mise à jour Android est disponible, ce qui peut parfois vous faire gagner un peu de temps. Dans tous les cas, la patience est de mise.
 👉🏻 Suivez l’actualité tech en temps réel : ajoutez 01net à vos sources sur Google, et abonnez-vous à notre canal WhatsApp.
Source : Android Authority

articles.title: Qualcomm wins architecture breach verdict against Arm but gets just $2 — judge could still suspend royalty fees for five years
articles.text:
Qualcomm wins architecture breach verdict against Arm but gets just $2 — judge could still suspend royalty fees for five years
But the fight is far from over.
Following its win against Arm in its licensing dispute around CPU cores developed by Nuvia, Qualcomm sued Arm in the U.S. early this year, accusing its partner of breaching the terms of their contract and causing damages to the company. This week a federal jury in Delaware has ruled that Arm indeed breached its contractual obligations with Qualcomm and intentionally interfered with the chipmaker's business relationship with Meta. However, the jury awarded Qualcomm only $2 in nominal damages and rejected several other claims against Arm. As a result, both companies declared victory in the latest round of their legal dispute, which could still have massive financial consequences.
The verdict followed a five-day trial in Wilmington, Delaware, during which Qualcomm accused Arm of violating the Architecture License Agreement (ALA), withholding software patches and processor verification tools, and refusing to offer commercially reasonable licensing terms. In particular, Qualcomm alleged that Arm deliberately withheld Arm Compliance Kit (ACK) verification materials and software patches necessary to validate its custom CPUs. Qualcomm also claimed that Arm refused to renew licenses for Cortex-A720, Cortex-A520, and Cortex-M55 processor cores under its Technology License Agreement (TLA).
Qualcomm further alleged that Arm deliberately undermined its relationships with customers by threatening to terminate its architecture license and leaking the corresponding notice to the media in October 2024. The company said that Arm's actions disrupted its negotiations with Meta and other customers, which caused financial losses as the company failed to land contracts with certain clients. Arm denied any wrongdoing and argued that Qualcomm had failed to demonstrate substantial financial losses. The company also indicated that Qualcomm intended to use the litigation to obtain more favorable licensing terms and avoid billions of dollars in royalty payments.
The jury sided with Qualcomm on two issues. First, it determined that Arm had breached its longstanding ALA, which allows Qualcomm to develop and sell custom processors compatible with Arm's instruction set architecture. Second, it found that Arm had intentionally interfered with Qualcomm's business relationship with Meta. Qualcomm welcomed the verdict and maintained that it exposed Arm's efforts to undermine its business and eventually become a Meta supplier.
"We are gratified that the jury found Arm breached its long-standing Architectural License Agreement (ALA) with Qualcomm, failed to honor its commitments, and intentionally acted to disrupt Qualcomm's businesses," a statement by Qualcomm reads. "Together with Qualcomm's prior court victory, this outcome further exposes Arm’s broader intentions to harm Qualcomm and its ecosystem. This outcome is a victory for innovation and competition, and we remain focused on developing and delivering industry-leading semiconductor products including our Oryon CPUs to customers and consumers worldwide."
However, Arm prevailed on four of Qualcomm's six claims submitted to the jury and was ordered to pay just $1 in damages on each of the aforementioned two. The original complaint included allegations of breaches of the ALA and TLA, violations of the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing, intentional and negligent interference with prospective economic advantage, and unfair competition. The precise findings on the individual allegations have yet to be revealed, as at press time the jury rulings were not available. Arm claims that the outcome supports its position that it had acted in good faith under its technology license agreement.
"We are pleased with the jury’s decision today finding for Arm on four claims and awarding only one dollar in damages on each of Qualcomm’s other two claims," a spokesperson for Arm said. "Despite Qualcomm's pursuit of this case in an attempt to deprive Arm of billions of dollars under our license agreements, the jury's verdict confirms that Arm operated in good faith under its technology license agreement and its award of only two dollars confirms the merit of Arm’s arguments in the case."
| Row 0 - Cell 0 | Qualcomm’s complaint | Details of the allegation | Outcome | 
| I | Breach of the Architecture License Agreement (ALA) | Arm allegedly violated provisions of Qualcomm’s ALA, including its obligations concerning the agreement’s validity and Qualcomm’s licensing rights. | Not separately confirmed | 
| II | Breach of the ALA — failure to deliver technical resources | Arm allegedly withheld Arm Compliance Kit (ACK) verification materials, out-of-band (OOB) test lists, and software patches needed to validate Qualcomm’s custom processors. | Qualcomm prevailed on an ALA breach claim, but the exact count requires confirmation. | 
| III | Breach of the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing | Arm allegedly acted in bad faith by withholding technical resources, threatening license termination, interfering with customers, and refusing to negotiate future licensing terms. | Exact disposition unconfirmed. A related good-faith negotiation issue was considered separately by the judge. | 
| IV | Intentional interference with prospective economic advantage | Arm allegedly deliberately disrupted Qualcomm’s relationships with customers, including Meta, through its license-termination threats and communications. | Qualcomm prevailed on intentional interference concerning Meta. | 
| V | Negligent interference with prospective economic advantage | Arm allegedly failed to exercise reasonable care when its actions disrupted Qualcomm’s existing and prospective customer relationships. | Not separately confirmed | 
| VI | Violation of California’s Unfair Competition Law | Arm allegedly engaged in unfair business practices intended to prevent Qualcomm from competing with Arm’s processor designs. | Not separately confirmed | 
| VII | Breach of the Technology License Agreement (TLA) | Arm allegedly failed to offer commercially reasonable licensing terms for processor IP, including Cortex-A720, Cortex-A520, and Cortex-M55. | Arm prevailed on TLA-related claims, but the exact count requires confirmation. | 
| VIII | Breach of another TLA provision | Arm allegedly violated additional contractual protections concerning the terms offered for processor IP. | Arm prevailed on TLA-related claims, but the exact count requires confirmation. | 
Despite the nominal $2 damages award, the legal battle between Qualcomm and Arm is not over. U.S. District Judge Maryellen Noreika must still determine whether Arm's breach of its Architecture License Agreement entitles Qualcomm to suspend royalty payments for five years, potentially costing Arm hundreds of millions, or even billions, in revenue. The judge must also decide whether Arm violated its obligation to negotiate future architecture licensing terms in good faith. Both decisions could have substantially greater financial and commercial consequences than the jury's verdict, and either company could appeal an unfavorable ruling.

articles.title: 50 W, USB-C et supports inclinés : VULKKANO soigne son kit de bureau
articles.text:
Avec VULKKANO DESK, la marque espagnol VULKKANO lance aujourd’hui son premier système audio pensé spécifiquement pour le bureau. Deux petites enceintes compactes, 50 W RMS, plusieurs options de connexion et un prix de 89,99 €. De quoi améliorer sensiblement le quotidien, sans pour autant transformer son espace de travail en studio.
Entre les enceintes intégrées souvent limitées des ordinateurs portables, la puissance toute relative des haut-parleurs intégrés à certains moniteurs et les systèmes audio plus imposants destinés aux installations hi-fi, il reste une petite place pour des solutions simples, compactes et accessibles. C’est précisément sur ce terrain que VULKKANO s’est fait une place ces dernières années, avec des produits audio conçus pour associer qualité sonore, polyvalence et tarifs contenus.
Un système compact qui ne fait pas l’impasse sur le son
Avec ce nouveau kit VULKKANO DESK, la marque franchit aujourd’hui une nouvelle étape en lançant sa première solution audio pensée exclusivement pour le bureau. Disponible en noir ou en blanc, le système entend répondre aux besoins des télétravailleurs, créateurs de contenu, joueurs ou simplement des utilisateurs qui souhaitent profiter d’un rendu sonore digne de ce nom devant leur PC, sans sacrifier leur espace de travail.
Avec seulement 10 × 15 × 16,5 cm par enceinte, VULKKANO DESK reste particulièrement discret sur un bureau. Chaque enceinte affiche un poids de 2,05 kg, tandis que leur format permet de les installer facilement de part et d’autre d’un écran, même lorsque l’espace disponible est limité.
Mais le constructeur ne s’est pas contenté de réduire le volume occupé. La marque indique que son VULKKANO DESK embarque un amplificateur AD82088D capable de délivrer 50 W RMS, avec une réponse en fréquence annoncée de 45 Hz à 20 kHz. Une configuration qui doit permettre de profiter d’un son plus ample aussi bien pour la musique que pour les films, les jeux vidéo ou les visioconférences.
Un autre détail intéressant concerne les supports de bureau inclinés qui sont ici fournis directement dans la boîte. Ceux-ci permettent de découpler les enceintes de la surface du bureau tout en orientant le son vers l’utilisateur. Un petit accessoire presque anodin en apparence, mais qui peut faire une vraie différence à l’écoute (en plus d’un rendu très élégant) et dont la présence évite surtout de devoir ajouter quelques dizaines d’euros à la facture pour obtenir une installation correctement positionnée.
USB-C, Bluetooth, ARC : DESK veut s’adapter à tous les usages
Sur un bureau, la connectique compte presque autant que la qualité sonore. A cet effet, VULKKANO DESK propose justement plusieurs possibilités pour s’adapter à des configurations très différentes.
La présence d’une entrée USB-C permet notamment de relier directement un ordinateur portable ou fixe, tout en conservant une installation relativement propre. Ce n’est pas tout, puisque le système prend également en charge le Bluetooth, ainsi que les connexions AUX et ARC, ce qui ouvre la porte à d’autres usages, par exemple avec un téléviseur, une console ou un smartphone.
Et pour ceux qui souhaitent aller plus loin dans les graves, VULKKANO a également prévu une sortie SUB OUT. De cette manière, le système peut tout à fait évoluer avec l’ajout d’un caisson de basses, sans devoir en aucun cas remplacer les enceintes.
Cette compatibilité prend évidemment tout son sens avec le VULKKANO SUB6 MKII, le caisson de basses maison, avec lequel DESK peut former un ensemble 2.1 particulièrement compact. Le caisson vient alors renforcer les basses pour les jeux et les films, toujours en conservant une empreinte limitée.
VULKKANO DESK disponible dès aujourd’hui à 89,99 €
Proposé à 89,99 €, le nouveau système audio se positionne ainsi sur un segment plutôt accessible, tout en intégrant plusieurs fonctionnalités que l’on ne retrouve pas forcément toujours à ce niveau de prix : 50 W RMS, USB-C, Bluetooth, ARC, sortie pour caisson de basses, supports inclinés fournis…
Avec DESK, VULKKANO mise donc sur une idée assez simple, celle d’offrir au bureau une véritable solution audio, suffisamment compacte pour rester discrète, suffisamment élégante pour s’installer sur un bureau de travail, et suffisamment polyvalente pour accompagner aussi bien une journée de travail qu’une session de jeu ou une session multimédia.

articles.title: Apple Announces the Next Generation of HomePod mini
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 13th 2026
Apple Announces the Next Generation of HomePod mini
Apple today announced HomePod mini 2, featuring Siri AI, gorgeous new colors, and enhanced audio experiences. Siri AI, coming to HomePod mini 2 in a future software update, is a profoundly more capable and conversational assistant with personal context understanding, broad world knowledge that powers tasks like richer music discovery, and the ability to tap into even more apps—bringing a whole new level of capability to HomePod mini.
Users can enjoy room-filling audio with a single speaker, in a stereo pair, or using multiroom audio. When paired with the new Apple TV 4K, HomePod mini 2 supports four-speaker surround sound—Apple's most immersive home theater setup yet. And HomePod mini makes it easy for different users to manage the connected home with just a voice command, securely controlling accessories and running automations.HomePod mini 2 can be pre-ordered starting today in pink, green, blue, white, and midnight, with availability beginning Friday, October 30.
Kaiann Drance, Apple's vice president of Worldwide Home Product Marketing"HomePod mini 2 brings together Siri AI, gorgeous new colors, and incredible audio. With Siri AI, it understands you better than ever, drawing on personal context and broad world knowledge to make music discovery even richer. It fills a room with sound on its own, which gets even bigger in a stereo pair or with multiroom audio, and when paired with the new Apple TV 4K, it delivers our most immersive home theater setup yet. And with just your voice, HomePod mini makes it easy to securely control your accessories and run automations across the connected home."
Siri AI Transforms the HomePod mini Experience
Powered by an entirely new architecture built on the latest generation of Apple Foundation Models, Siri AI transforms the HomePod mini experience and helps users get more done than ever before.
When paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad, HomePod mini can tap into a user's personal context to help them find what they need in the moment. HomePod mini can recognize up to six users in a household by their voice and securely connect to their device across apps like Messages and timers, while playing their favorite music, and more. Siri AI can also privately act on this context across a user's iPhone and iPad apps to complete tasks like finding a song a friend recommended in a text, setting a reminder tied to a calendar event or location, locating a recipe from an email, or adding ingredients to a grocery list. With broad world knowledge, Siri AI can answer questions on almost any topic by getting up-to-date information from the web. And users can go back and forth with Siri in a conversation like never before.
Once Siri AI is enabled on a supported HomePod mini speaker, even users without an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone or iPad will benefit from Siri AI's broad world knowledge; its ability to have rich, natural conversations; and its improved music discovery.
Immersive Audio Experiences
HomePod mini delivers rich 360-degree sound from its compact footprint, whether it's used as a single speaker, in a stereo pair, or as part of a multiroom audio setup. Powered by the Apple S10 chip and advanced computational audio, it analyzes music in real time to optimize dynamic range, loudness, and acoustic performance. For the first time, users can create a four-speaker surround sound experience with Apple TV 4K (4th generation) and HomePod mini 2. Together, the four speakers and the new Apple TV 4K intelligently recognize each speaker's position in the room, so audio timing and levels are automatically calibrated to the space.The new HomePod mini can serve as a speaker for Mac, delivering expansive sound for everything from movies and gaming to FaceTime and video calls. Finished in complementary colors, the new HomePod mini creates a beautifully unified desktop setup with Mac.
Introducing Sound Glow
With Sound Glow, the top of HomePod mini transforms into a visual canvas that glows and pulses in sync with the music, reacting in real time to bass and treble. The song's album artwork from Now Playing generates a color-matched light experience that's unique to every song, and users can pick a soundscape like rain to trigger bespoke animations for a soothing atmosphere.
Effortless Smart Home Management
HomePod mini makes controlling the connected home easy at an incredible value. With just their voice, users can conduct a series of smart home actions, including locking the front door; closing the garage when leaving the house; and lowering the blinds, adjusting the thermostat, or turning off the lights at bedtime. With the Home app, users can automate their smart home accessories and create scenes to control multiple accessories at the same time. As a home hub, HomePod mini also lets users securely control accessories from the Home app on iPhone, whether they're at home or away.Sound Recognition gives HomePod mini users peace of mind by listening for a smoke or carbon monoxide alarm and, if one is detected, sending a notification immediately to the user's iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. Using the Home app, users can check in via HomePod mini and listen and talk to someone at home to make sure everything is all right.
The new HomePod mini also works seamlessly with smart home accessories, including Apple Home Collection video doorbells and cameras, using Face Recognition to announce who is at the door.
Private and Secure by Design
As with every Apple product, privacy and security are foundational to HomePod mini. Siri AI takes full advantage of the bold new architecture for Apple Intelligence. Siri requests on HomePod mini 2 can use on-device processing or Private Cloud Compute, which extends the privacy of the device to the cloud. When processed in Private Cloud Compute, data is not stored or made accessible to Apple or anyone else.
With powerful new features and unrivaled privacy protections, Siri remains the world's most private digital assistant.
HomePod mini 2 and the Environment
HomePod mini 2 is built with the environment in mind and drives progress toward Apple's ambitious plan to be carbon-neutral across its entire footprint by 2030. HomePod mini features 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets, and 100 percent recycled copper, gold plating, and tin solder in all Apple-designed printed circuit boards. HomePod mini 2 meets Apple's high standards for energy efficiency and safe chemistry. As with all Apple products, its paper packaging is 100 percent fiber-based and designed to be recycled.Pricing and Availability
- Customers in the U.S. and more than 23 other countries and regions can pre-order HomePod mini 2 starting today from apple.com/store and in the Apple Store app in pink, green, blue, white, and midnight, with availability in stores beginning Friday, October 30.
- HomePod mini 2 is available for $149 (U.S.).
- Siri AI will be available in English on HomePod mini 2 via a future software update in the U.S., Australia, Canada, India, New Zealand, Singapore, South Africa, and the UK.
- HomePod mini 2 is compatible with HomePod software 27.2.
