articles.title: I escaped from Nemesis on the Nintendo Switch 2 edition of Resident Evil 3, and it’s a highly capable port with smooth performance and solid visuals
articles.text:
TechRadar Verdict
Resident Evil 3 looks and feels great on Nintendo Switch 2, with consistent frame rates, faithful visuals, and smooth controls. It would’ve been nice to see this port take advantage of the Switch 2’s gyro aiming or mouse controls, but this won’t be a dealbreaker for most players. Meanwhile, the core game is one of the most high-octane entries in the series, and conjures up an immensely tense atmosphere — even if it lacks the depth and strong narrative of its predecessor.
Reasons to buy
- + Smooth performance
- + Good visual fidelity in handheld and docked mode
- + Still an extremely tense, atmospheric survival horror experience
Reasons to avoid
- - Doesn’t take advantage of Switch 2’s motion or mouse modes
- - Core game held back by short runtime and average narrative
Why you can trust TechRadar
We spend hours testing every product or service we review, so you can be sure you're buying the best. Find out more about how we test.
While a lot of fans have been mixed on Capcom’s remake of Resident Evil 3 since its initial release in 2020, there’s no denying that it's an incredibly tense survival horror experience that’s filled to the brim with high-octane action. And now, you can experience Jill Valentine and Carlos Oliveira’s terrifying journey on the go, thanks to a new Nintendo Switch 2 port.
Platform reviewed: Nintendo Switch 2
Available on: PS4, PS5, Nintendo Switch (cloud only), Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox One, Xbox Series X and Series S, PC, iOS
Release date: October 16, 2026 (Switch 2 edition)
I’ve spent more than 10 hours playing Resident Evil 3 on Nintendo Switch 2, experiencing the main story in full. So, is it a port that’s worth your time and money? Here’s my take.
For the most part, I want to focus on the quality of this port on Nintendo’s latest hybrid system, but before we delve into that, I’d like to share a few thoughts on the remake of Resident Evil 3 in itself.
Nemesis is coming for you...
I played through the Resident Evil 2 remake right before this entry, and while there are a lot of similarities in terms of the combat, resource management, environments, and visuals, they have a few striking differences.
Above all, Resident Evil 3 feels far more focused on the action — it feels like you’re constantly on the run, blasting through zombies, and rushing to save the people of Raccoon City. In some ways, this works to the game’s advantage: the horrifying Nemesis is a truly daunting foe, the high-paced gameplay is engaging from start to finish, and the explosive set pieces make this entry feel truly cinematic.
However, the fast pace and distinct action focus come with its drawbacks. The game’s runtime is very short — you’ll easily finish this one in about six hours. On top of that, the overall narrative feels a bit thin, and there are very few puzzles. Ultimately, Resident Evil 3 is still a blast, and its likeable cast and engrossing gameplay make it worth playing alone — it just doesn’t quite have the depth of some of the best entries in the series.
OK, I thought Mr. X was frightening in Resident Evil 2, but Nemesis is on a whole other level. He’s far more deadly and imposing, and when he whipped out a flamethrower on the rooftop, I was bricking it. All of the battles against him feel so incredibly tense yet enjoyable, and ended up being my favorite parts of this adventure.
Anyway, let’s talk about how this title plays on Switch 2 specifically. And good news — the Resident Evil 3 remake runs very well on this system. The Switch 2 edition targets 60 frames per second (fps), and I enjoyed smooth frame rates in both docked and handheld mode with barely any noticeable drops. Yes, the movement of some distant enemies could appear a little shaky — something I also saw in the Resident Evil 2 remake on Switch 2 — but even the most action-packed segments of the game were silky smooth.
Sign up for breaking news, reviews, opinion, top tech deals, and more.
While you could probably get a more premium visual presentation from a gaming PC or PS5 Pro, the game’s graphics also translate well onto Nintendo Switch 2 after calibrating HDR. The dark, moody environments look sharp and intricate in docked mode, with character models looking pleasantly detailed. Contrast is solid too, with colors popping against the dismal city streets, though it’s worth noting that in handheld mode there’s a noticeable (yet understandable) hit to graphical fidelity — though the game still looks very decent overall.
The game also controls nicely, and you can switch between a few different schemes in the options menu, although it would’ve been neat to see gyro aiming, which worked well on the Switch 2 edition of Resident Evil Requiem. There’s also no mouse mode integration, and more generally, it would’ve been nice to see this version play to the Switch 2’s strengths a bit more. One thing that I did like, though, was the Switch 2’s virtual spatial sound, which provides an expansive, almost three-dimensional soundscape when you’re battling through hordes of zombies.
In the end, then, it’s easy for me to recommend the Resident Evil 3 remake on Switch 2. While the graphics won’t wow you in handheld mode and the core game isn’t without its flaws, it consistently runs at a stable frame rate, visuals are strong in docked mode (and still more than adequate in handheld), and the action-packed gameplay is sure to keep you absorbed in the game from start to finish.
Should you play Resident Evil 3 for Nintendo Switch 2?
Play it if…
You want to experience Resident Evil 3 on the go with little compromise
I was very pleased with this Switch 2 port’s performance. It looks very solid overall, especially in docked mode, and you’ll get smooth frame rates for satisfying and seamless gameplay, both at home and on the go.
You’re looking for a brief survival horror game to blast through
The remake of Resident Evil 3 has a very brief runtime. I finished it up in about six hours, and while I feel that it could’ve offered more, some may appreciate its brevity. Sometimes, it’s fun to just fly through a brief, action-packed experience, and Resident Evil 3 offers exactly that.
Don’t play it if…
You want the best performance possible
For those of you looking for peak performance, then the PS5 Pro or PC might be the better destination for playing this title. That being said, the visuals and performance of the Switch 2 version are commendable, and the benefit of getting to play the game on the move is massive.
You’ve never played a Resident Evil game before
Resident Evil 3 isn’t the best starting point for series newcomers. The events that play out are deeply connected to those of Resident Evil 2, which I’d suggest as an entry point for anyone looking to get into the franchise.
Accessibility features
The options menu allows you to make a few changes to your experience, with a range of camera options, three separate control schemes, toggle or hold run modes, and a range of voice and text languages available. What’s more, you can change the color of the reticle, laser dot sight, and dot display, alter HUD opacity, and tone down damage display if you’d prefer.
How I reviewed Resident Evil 3 for Nintendo Switch 2
I sunk just over 10 hours into the Resident Evil 3 remake on Nintendo Switch 2, during which time I finished the main story and tried playing in both docked and handheld mode.
Most of the time, I played the game docked, with my Switch 2 connected to the Sky Glass Gen 2 TV and Marshall Heston 120 soundbar. I did try out handheld mode from time to time, though, and used my JBL Live Beam 4 earbuds to experience the game’s virtual spatial sound.
More generally, I’m an experienced gaming hardware and software reviewer, and have been testing all kinds of games and accessories at TechRadar for years now, where I serve as a Senior Reviews Writer. I’ve reviewed all sorts of Nintendo Switch 2 titles, from major first-party releases like Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave to ports like Yakuza Kiwami. I’ve also played a number of Resident Evil games, including the Switch 2 port of the Resident Evil 2 remake.
First reviewed October 2026
Harry is a Senior Reviews Writer for TechRadar. He reviews everything from party speakers to wall chargers and has a particular interest in the worlds of audio and gaming. Harry has a background in business tech journalism, particularly around the telecoms industry.

articles.title: New Apple product: The Apple HomeView
articles.text:
Apple has announced a range of new smart home devices and a partnership with LG and Schneider Electric. Of the new smart home products, the most intriguing is the Apple HomeView, a smart home speaker with an attached display.
I realized I was so interested in the HomeView that I stopped taking notes and just listened and asked questions during the presentation. So I’m excited to dive in:
Introducing the Apple HomeView
View this post on Instagram
The Apple HomeView sports a 7-inch Liquid Retina smart display and comes in Space Grey, Silver, Starlight and Rose Pink. However, you can also get a wall-mounted version in Space Grey and Silver.
The smart display will intelligently adapt to each person. For instance, when I approach the HomeView, it’ll unlock with my face — it’s not the same technology as Face ID, but I’ll dive into that later.
After you unlock the display, you’ll see your home screen, where you can access apps like Apple Music, FaceTime, Messages, Safari, and Apple TV. You can resume the show you were watching on Apple TV, listen to your playlists on Apple Music, and reply to text messages. But when you walk away, HomeView locks itself, preventing your partner or kids from accessing your Messages. Next time it unlocks, it’ll open to their own home screen, which might look completely different from yours, with different widgets and apps.
Because the device itself doesn’t use the same hardware as Face ID on your iPad or iPhone, Apple has taken extra measures to keep it secure. This includes being on the Home account, specifically registering your face/voice with HomeView, having your smartphone connected to the same Wi-Fi or recently in the same location, and having recently unlocked it. If HomeView isn’t sure it’s you, it’ll ask you to unlock your handset to verify.
While I haven’t had hands-on time with the device, I saw a few demos, and they looked pretty cool. For instance, I saw how the HomeView handles recipes. So if you have your HomeView in the kitchen (though it doesn’t need to be in the kitchen for this) and you pull up a recipe, it shows two tabs: one for ingredients and one for directions. It even shows how long each step will take, and you can set a timer with Siri or with a tap. After this, the demoer asked Siri what time the Tribeca market opens, then asked Siri to add berries to her shopping list and remind her to grab bags 10 minutes before the market opens. Afterward, Siri showed a visual confirmation that it added this to her reminders, indicating it worked without a hitch.
We saw another demo where you can ask HomeView to play a song shared by a friend. The user said, “Siri, play that song Dave sent me.” It immediately went over to Apple Music and started playing a Bad Bunny song. You could also show the lyrics for a karaoke night, or show the animated album art that looked great on the 7-inch display.
Of course, it has room-filling audio (literally, it presented this in an open-concept room with two kitchen sections and a living room in between), two drivers, and four mics, including far-field mics that can pick up your voice from farther away. Like the Apple Watch, the HomeView has tons of faces you can show when you’re not using it. You can set different widgets, colours, and styles like an Apple Watch; pick your favourite photos, or even choose an animated Snoopy one that reacts to the weather and holidays.
The wall-mounted variant loses two speakers, but Apple says it still delivers great sound by using technology that takes advantage of the wall. You’re able to wall-mount it yourself, but you’ll see the hanging wire. There are two other ways of wall-mounting the device to hide the power cord, but Apple suggests you leave it up to the professionals.
The HomeView is only compatible with iOS 27.2 (so you might need an update).
I’ve reviewed smart home products before, but this was literally the first time I considered pre-ordering a smart home device for myself. Speaking of pre-orders, they open today, and the HomeView officially releases on November 13. The Apple HomeView costs C$429.

articles.title: Star Citizen Dev's Squadron 42 Space Fighter Gets Steam Page and Mid-2027 Launch
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 13th 2026
Star Citizen Dev's Squadron 42 Space Fighter Gets Steam Page and Mid-2027 Launch
Cloud Imperium Games has just published the Steam Store page for the upcoming Squadron 42, a single-player Star Citizen spinoff game that puts the narrative and cinematic action front and center. Instead of the multiplayer gameplay mix of Star Citizen. Squadron 42 has also received a promised Q2 2027 release date, suggesting that the game will launch before July 2027. Initially, the game was slated to launch before the end of 2026, and in 2015 before that. 
Based on the Squadron 42 Steam page, the game will see players step into the shoes of a new recruit in the UEE Navy, which is engaged in the early days of a galactic war. Players will face off against a number of alien races in a variety of combat scenarios, including everything from space-bound dogfights and ship exploration missions to ground-based FPS-style combat against a variety of alien enemies. The Steam page also hints at choices-matter gameplay elements, suggesting there will be multiple endings or some sort of morals system involved. More details will likely be revealed soon enough, but Squadron has earned 18,000 followers on Steam since the store page went live.
Enlist as a rookie in the UEE Navy and step into a cinematic, single-player space adventure where you are at the center of the action. Live, work, and fight alongside your crew, brought to life by an all-star cast, as the story unfolds across fighter cockpits, capital ships, space stations, frontier outposts, and the front lines of a galactic war. Through intense combat, sacrifice, and the choices you make when it matters most, you will earn your place, your rank, and your legacy. You don't watch the rise of a hero. You become one.

articles.title: Rekord im All: Der Marsrover Perseverance ist so weit gefahren wie kein anderes Fahrzeug außerhalb der Erde
articles.text:
Perseverance überholt Opportunity – und stellt damit einen neuen Rekord auf
Die Aufgabe von Perseverance ist es, auf der Oberfläche des roten Planeten nach Spuren von früherem Leben zu suchen. Dabei hat das Fahrzeug jetzt einen neuen Rekord aufgestellt. Wie die Nasa in einem Beitrag mitteilt, übertraf Perseverance am 11. Oktober 2026 den bisherigen Streckenrekord des Rovers Opportunity. Dieser kam im Jahr 2018 nach einer Entfernung von rund 45 Kilometern endgültig zum Stillstand. Perseverance ist also weiter gefahren als jedes andere Fahrzeug im Sonnensystem außerhalb der Erde.
Rekord des Rovers wurde schon früher erwartet
Das Jet Propulsion Laboratory am Caltech-Institut in Kalifornien baute den Marsrover im Auftrag der Nasa und betreibt ihn seitdem. Die Missionsleiter:innen hatten ursprünglich erwartet, dass Perseverance diesen Meilenstein schon im August erreichen würde. Dann stieß er aber auf helle Gesteinsbrocken, die das Interesse der Forscher:innen erregten. Sie könnten zu den ältesten gehören, die jemals auf dem Mars untersucht wurden. Dadurch verzögerte sich das Vorankommen des Rovers auf dem roten Planeten.
„Die Wissenschaft ist der Grund, warum sich der Rover auf der Marsoberfläche befindet”, sagte die Wissenschaftlerin Katie Stack Morgan Anfang Oktober in einem Interview mit der New York Times. „Wir freuen uns darauf, den Rekord zu brechen, wenn es soweit ist. Aber bis dahin sind es die Gesteinsformationen, die die Mission wirklich vorantreiben.“ Bisher gibt es keine Anzeichen dafür, dass der Betrieb des Marsrovers bald enden könnte. Er wird also voraussichtlich noch viele weitere Kilometer auf der Marsoberfläche zurücklegen.
Rover Perseverance verlasst den Jezero-Krater
Das erste Ziel des Marsrovers war der Jezero-Krater, in dem er am 18. Februar 2021 landete. In dieser Senke hat sich in den frühen Jahren des Sonnensystems, als der Planet noch wärmer und feuchter war, ein See befunden. Die Mission besteht darin, über die Oberfläche zu fahren und Gestein und Bodenproben auf mögliche Biosignaturen, geologische Prozesse und die Entwicklung des Planeten zu untersuchen. So soll Perseverance Hinweise auf früheres Leben finden. Ähnlich wie schon einige Autos auf der Erde nutzt der Rover dazu autonomes Fahren. Damit findet er den Weg selbst, ohne detaillierte Anweisungen von der Erde zu benötigen.
Perseverance hat den Jezero-Krater inzwischen verlassen. Bisher stehe noch nicht fest, welche Region der Rover als nächstes erkunden soll. Irgendwann muss die Nasa außerdem entscheiden, was mit den Gesteinsproben passieren soll, die Perseverance bisher gesammelt hat. Ein Projekt namens „Mars Sample Return“, das die Proben zur Erde zurückbringen sollte, wurde aus Kostengründen abgesagt. Trotzdem wird das Fahrzeug noch eine Weile auf dem roten Planeten unterwegs sein. Vor dem Start gab die Nasa an, dass Perseverance bis zu 20 Kilometer zurückzulegen könne. Diese Marke hat der Rover inzwischen weit übertroffen. Jetzt hat die Nasa den nächsten Meilenstein von 100 Kilometern ins Visier genommen.

articles.title: El calendario completo de 'VisionQuest', explicado: número de episodios y fechas de estreno
articles.text:
Marvel acaba de estrenar en Disney+ su nueva serie, VisionQuest. Un proyecto que es mucho más que un simple contenido extra para engrosar su catálogo en streaming. Y es que el título es, por un lado, el último estreno marvelita antes de Avengers: Doomsday. Por otro lado, es también el cierre de la Trilogía de Wanda que arrancó en 2021 con WandaVision y continuó en 2024 con Agatha All Along.
Visión, reiniciado y tras escapar de quienes pretendían convertirlo en arma, ha permanecido oculto. En busca de un nuevo propósito, consulta a las distintas IA integradas en su programación, incluidas F.R.I.D.A.Y., E.D.I.T.H., J.A.R.V.I.S. y el infame Ultrón. Su discreta existencia llega a su fin cuando una recompensa por su captura lo obliga a huir junto a Thomas Shepherd, un misterioso joven que podría ser su hijo reencarnado. Mientras evita ser capturado, Visión deberá enfrentarse a su propia naturaleza, resistir la influencia de Ultrón y desentrañar el enigma de su joven acompañante si quiere sobrevivir.
Los dos primeros episodios de VisionQuest ya han llegado a Disney+ en lo que sin lugar a dudas era uno de los estrenos de superhéroes más esperados del año. A partir de ahora, Marvel seguirá con la serie una estrategia de estreno semanal bastante particular. La Casa de las Ideas lanzará dos nuevos capítulos durante las próximas dos semanas. Sin embargo, para los dos últimos episodios se optará por un lanzamiento individual en lugar de doble. De esta forma se llegará al octavo y último de ellos, que será el final de temporada.
Calendario de estreno de VisionQuest
Con esta estrategia de estreno cada martes, el calendario completo de VisionQuest es el siguiente.
- Sin ataduras (Episodio 1): martes 13 de octubre.
- Teseo (Episodio 2): martes 13 de octubre.
- Reboot (Episodio 3): martes 20 de octubre.
- Malware (Episodio 4): martes 20 de octubre.
- Firewall (Episodio 5): martes 27 de octubre.
- Deadlock (Episodio 6): martes 27 de octubre.
- Immolation (Episodio 7): martes 3 de noviembre.
- Forever (Episodio 8): martes 10 de noviembre.
*IMPORTANTE: En España los capítulos se estrenan en la madrugada del miércoles debido a la diferencia horaria.

articles.title: How To Define CPU And Software Stack Performance For Agentic AI
articles.text:
Home >
                                                                    Low Power-High Performance >
                                                                How To Define CPU And Software Stack Performance For Agentic AI                                                    
Low Power-High Performance
                        WHITEPAPERS
		
Measuring the performance demands of agentic AI; assessing CPU bottlenecks, SW stack efficiency, and system-level tradeoffs.
								October 14th, 2026 - 
								By: Arm
								
							
Agentic AI changes the CPU performance problem. A completed task can involve repeated model calls, retrieval, state management, tool execution, application interactions, policy checks and validation loops. Accelerators remain central to model execution, while CPUs coordinate and execute much of the surrounding system path from user intent to completed work.
This paper proposes a use-case-driven framework for evaluating that CPU contribution. It separates CPU-visible work into two complementary areas: common agentic framework functions and use-case-specific tool workloads. Five representative workload archetypes are used to capture distinct deployment venues, tool classes and CPU stress profiles. The paper then describes two complementary measurement approaches: component benchmarking, which emphasizes reproducibility and attribution and end-to-end benchmarking, which emphasizes realistic task-level outcomes.
The objective is not to prescribe a finished benchmark suite or a single figure of merit. It is to define the measurement boundaries, workload categories and methodological gaps that need industry agreement. In particular, replayable agent trajectories offer a path to separating CPU work from model and network effects while reducing the run-to-run variability introduced by non-deterministic agent behavior.

articles.title: Hay personas que hablan tan alto que parecen enfadadas. La psicología tiene una explicación para ello
articles.text:
Hay personas a nuestro alrededor que tienen un tono de voz extremadamente alto cuando están hablando en persona o a través del teléfono, hasta el punto de que podemos llegar a pensar que están muy enfadados. Pero en realidad estas personas no son agresivas, sino que expresan sus emociones de una forma bastante diferente.
Lo han analizado. La base científica que existe para analizar el tono que se usa a la hora de hablar apunta a que la intensidad de nuestra voz refleja nuestro estado emocional del momento, lo que se conoce en psicología como 'activación' o 'arousal'.
El estudio de referencia en este campo fue publicado en 1996, donde se analizaron acústicamente 224 interpretaciones de 14 emociones distintas, confirmando que los parámetros vocales revelan el grado de intensidad típico de una emoción. Años más tarde, en 2003, un nuevo análisis apuntó también a que hay patrones acústicos específicos para las emociones. Con todo esto sacamos como conclusión que cuando el sistema nervioso se acelera, el volumen sube.
Gritamos de euforia. El volumen alto se asocia casi instintivamente con el enfado, pero la ciencia nos dice que no es exclusivo de las emociones negativas de nuestro día a día. Aquí los investigadores apuntan a que la intensidad media y la velocidad del habla varían con la activación emocional, sin importar si esa emoción es buena o mala.
De esta manera, la desesperación eleva la voz, pero la euforia y la alegría intensa también lo hacen. Es por ello que una persona no es agresiva cuando está contando a gritos que ha conseguido un trabajo nuevo, sino que su nivel de activación está por las nubes.
Dos conceptos diferentes. Aunque para cualquier persona los términos 'ira' y 'agresión' sean prácticamente idénticos, la realidad es que son diferentes. Aquí nos podemos ir a la Asociación Americana de Psicología, que apunta a que la ira es una emoción marcada por la tensión y la hostilidad, que se manifiesta a través de conductas inofensivas como insultar o elevar la voz.
Por el contrario, la agresión se define estrictamente como una conducta observable con la intención de dañar a otra persona o cosa. De esta manera, alguien puede estar muy enfadado y gritar de ira sin tener la más mínima intención de agredir a nadie.
La personalidad. Algo que sí se ha visto es que los que hablan fuerte por defecto son los extrovertidos. Y es que un estudio de 1978 se dedicó a analizar cómo diferentes sujetos deducían la personalidad a través de la voz y el único rasgo que la gente adivinaba correctamente basándose en el volumen, la energía y el rango dinámico era la extraversión. Así que esta es una razón más para entender a aquellas personas que entran a cualquier sitio hablando muy fuerte.
Lo innato. A la hora de analizar por qué la gente grita, hay que tener en cuenta también el entorno donde se encuentra ese sujeto, y aquí es donde llega el efecto Lombard, que fue descrito hace más de un siglo. Este no es más que un reflejo involuntario presente en humanos y otros animales, por el cual aumentamos la intensidad, el tono y la frecuencia de nuestra voz en entornos ruidosos para poder ser escuchados.

The company also introduced a collection of partner-developed smart home gadgets. Users can manage the devices via the Apple Home app that ships with the iPhone maker’s handsets.
Apple’s first smart display
The HomePod is a seven-inch display that automatically adjusts its brightness based on the time of day. When the user moves away from the device, it changes how graphics are rendered to improve viewability. A facial recognition feature enables HomeView to personalize the content that it displays based on up to six different users’ preferences.
The device will ship in two editions. The first is a wall-mounted model that comes with three mounts. It’s joined by a tabletop edition that sits on an aluminum base. A stainless steel hinge in the base allows HomeView to tilt, which enables users to manually adjust the viewing angle.
There are also other differences between the wall-mounted and tabletop models. The former edition includes two speakers, while the latter features three. Additionally, the tabletop HomeView includes two so-called force-cancelling passive radiators. They prevent the speakers from rattling the device’s chassis, which boosts audio quality.
New automation features
The second addition to Apple’s smart home portfolio is HomePod mini 2, the latest iteration of its entry-level smart speaker. It features a panel that displays light effects synced to the music being played. The device optimizes sound quality by automatically tailoring its acoustic settings to each track.
HomePod mini 2 runs its audio processing software on an Apple S10 chip, which made its original debut in the 2024 Apple Watch lineup. The processor also runs Apple’s Siri artificial intelligence assistant. Users can instruct the assistant to perform tasks in apps installed on an iPhone or iPad, as well as change the configuration of other smart home devices.
AI-powered home theater
The HomePod mini 2 is interoperable with the latest iteration of Apple TV 4K, which also made its debut today. The latter device is a set-top box that can be attached to a TV via a cable. It enables the connected display to access streaming services, run Siri and control other smart home devices.
Users can combine an Apple TV 4K with four HomePod mini 2 speakers to create a home theater setup. According to Apple, the speakers detect their position and calibrate their audio settings accordingly to optimize sound quality.
Apple TV 4K uses a custom A19 system-on-chip to manage the connected display and speakers. The chip’s built-in central processing unit provides up to 50% more performance than the one in the company’s previous set-top box. The integrated graphics processing unit, in turn, is up to twice as fast. Apple says that those improvements facilitate smoother interface navigation.
Streaming services deliver video content to users’ displays in a compressed format that saves bandwidth. The stream must be decompressed before it can be played. According to Apple, the A19 performs the task using a dedicated hardware module. The company says that the module lowers the Apple TV K4’s bandwidth consumption.
Apple will ship the box with an upgraded remote. The biggest addition is support for the company’s Find My service, which helps users locate lost devices by visualizing their position on a map. For added measure, the remote plays a sound that makes it easier to locate.
More third-party hardware
The Apple Home Collection is a new lineup of smart home devices developed by LG Corp. and Schneider Electric SE. There are four cameras, including one that doubles as a doorbell, plus a door lock and two thermostats. Users can optionally extend the thermostats with standalone temperature and humanity sensors that also debuted today.
All the devices connect to the Apple Home smart home management app, which enables users to remotely adjust their settings. There are also iPhone and Apple Watch integrations. LG’s smart door lock, for example, can automatically unlock if the user walks up to the door with an iPhone that stores a digital key.

articles.title: TechSparks 2026 Day 1: Sridhar Vembu, Priyank Kharge, spacetech founders chart India's 'New Tech Order'
articles.text:
TechSparks 2026 Day 1: Sridhar Vembu, Priyank Kharge, spacetech founders chart India's 'New Tech Order'
Day 1 of TechSparks 2026 featured Sridhar Vembu’s call for tech ownership over GPU spending, Priyank Kharge’s Beyond Bengaluru push, spacetech lessons from AgniKul and GalaxEye, and the Tech30 2026 launch.
The 17th edition of TechSparks opened in Bengaluru with a clear message for India's tech ecosystem: prosperity cannot be imported, and the country must learn to build and own the technologies that solve its own problems.
YourStory's flagship startup-tech summit, themed 'The New Tech Order', brought together founders, investors, policymakers and technologists to examine how India can move from providing technology services to owning foundational technology.
Vembu: Own the foundation before chasing AI
Setting the tone in his inaugural keynote, Zoho Co-founder and Chief Scientist Sridhar Vembu argued that India should prioritise infrastructure and foundational technologies over heavy spending on graphics processing units (GPUs).
"If I earn $10 billion right now, as a government, I will spend the money on Bangalore infrastructure, Chennai infrastructure, all that. There's no point spending $10 billion on GPUs right now," he said.
Vembu said the real obstacle to national prosperity is not the loss of outsourcing jobs but a lack of technology ownership. He claimed that India does 40–50% of Nvidia's chip design work and a large share of software development for Microsoft, Oracle and Cisco, but the financial returns flow to foreign IP holders.
"Ultimately, who has ownership of the technology determines what is the income level of the non-tech people in that economy," he said.
He also predicted major disruption to traditional coding, likening software to a handloom industry about to meet machine looms. By his estimate, AI already writes better code than 60–70% of software engineers and could outperform 90% within three to six months. Rather than lay off staff, he said, Zoho is redeploying engineers to deeptech hardware, including building server infrastructure in-house.
Vembu urged India to follow the path of East Asian economies, building foundational layers first, as China did with Baidu and WeChat. "As much as we think of China as adversaries, I actually look to them as gurus," he said.
Tech30 2026 unveiled
Day 1 also saw Vembu unveil Tech30 2026, YourStory's annual selection of 30 promising startups building India's next generation of technology. He was joined on stage by Yoonmin Cho, APJ Lead, Snowflake for Startups, and Amar Dixit, CEO, WOI India.
Chosen by a jury of ecosystem leaders along with YourStory's senior editorial and research teams, this year's cohort spans spacetech, defence, clean energy, advanced materials, agritech and healthcare. It includes counter-drone maker Apollyon Dynamics, NavIC chip developer MumbaiSemi, quantum-safe encryption startup Pramatra Space, laser-weeding robot maker Harvested Robotics, and Dognosis, which is developing a breath-based cancer screening test.
Kharge: Taking investment to where talent lives
Priyank Kharge, Minister for Home Affairs, IT, Biotechnology and E-Governance, Government of Karnataka, outlined the state's strategy to ease pressure on Bengaluru by bringing investment to where talent already exists.
In a fireside chat with YourStory Founder and CEO Shradha Sharma, Kharge said the Beyond Bengaluru Mission is showing results, with Mysuru delivering close to Rs 4,000 crore in IT exports, Mangaluru close to Rs 3,500 crore, and the Hubballi-Belagavi-Dharwad cluster close to Rs 3,000 crore.
He pointed to recent deals as proof of the policy's reach, including NTT's acquisition of two Udupi-based startups and acquisitions of semiconductor design companies in Belagavi and Mangaluru, some led by founders aged just 23 or 24. The state is also setting up region-specific centres of excellence, including AI centres at IIIT Dharwad and IIIT Raichur, an agritech centre in Kalaburagi and a horticulture centre in Bagalkot.
Spacetech: Building through rejection and failure
The day also turned the spotlight on the gritty reality of building India's private space sector. In conversation with Shradha Sharma, AgniKul Cosmos Co-founder and CEO Srinath Ravichandran and GalaxEye Co-founder and CEO Suyash Singh spoke about surviving hundreds of investor rejections—275 for AgniKul and around 100 for GalaxEye.
Ravichandran explained AgniKul's frugal pay-per-kilogram model, aiming for commercial viability at the $50–60 million mark. "It is more like you give me $500 million and then I will start giving you money back. That is not how India works," he said.
Singh recounted losing communication with GalaxEye's satellite just 30 days after launch, but said such setbacks are part of building the industry. He added that defence is one of the largest markets for space-based Earth observation. "Geopolitics is hotter, and space based surveillance is not an option. It is mandatory," he said.
Both founders flagged the scarcity of growth-stage capital and supply chain hurdles, but remained optimistic that ESOPs and stricter Western visa rules are drawing top engineering talent back to India's deeptech ecosystem.

articles.title: Ghostscript flaw lets hackers hijack servers via PDF uploads
articles.text:
A critical heap buffer overflow vulnerability (CVE-2026-39919) in the Ghostscript interpreter and rendering engine could allow remote code execution through specially crafted PDF files.
The flaw was discovered on August 23 by researchers at Defiant's platform Wordfence using their Argus AI-powered system.
Ghostscript is a PostScript and PDF interpreter that can render PDFs as images, generate thumbnails for previews, and optimize PDF files by compressing embedded images and removing unnecessary font data.
When generating a PDF thumbnail, WordPress can use the PHP Imagick extension to call ImageMagick, which launches Ghostscript.
A specially crafted PDF file containing a JPEG 2000 image can trigger incorrect handling of low-bit-depth samples and mismatched component resolutions.
Using Argus, the researchers developed two exploits for CVE-2026-39919 that force Ghostscript to write 1,024 bytes into a 256-byte buffer, corrupting nearby memory and leading to unauthenticated remote code execution in a WordPress deployment.
Wordfence focused on WordPress systems, but notes that the flaw affects any online system running Ghostscript 9.21 through 10.07.1 and is exploitable if the payload is adjusted to the environment.
The researchers tested ten Linux environments, including Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, Alpine, and AlmaLinux, as well as an official WordPress Docker image snapshot, and found that all contained the vulnerable code.
The researchers tested two proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits and found that their ability to trigger the vulnerability depended on the target environment.
In a lab testbed, they executed the exploits 10,240 times against Linux packages but failed to achieve remote code execution. However, they successfully executed code remotely on a purpose-built test server.
The researchers found that modifying the PDF's fonts, language settings, font configuration, and one core system library enabled the exploit to succeed, although not reliably.
In WordPress environments specifically, successful exploitation has four prerequisites:
- An attacker can upload a PDF, anonymously or through a low-privileged account.
- The site processes that PDF to generate a preview or thumbnail.
- The processing chain reaches Ghostscript, with the necessary software and policy settings permitting PDF rendering.
- Ghostscript contains the unpatched vulnerable decoding code.
Wordfence noted that stock WordPress does not permit anonymous Media Library uploads.
More generally, any application that renders attacker-supplied PDFs through affected Ghostscript code may expose the flaw, and authentication requirements for exploitation depend on the application.
Artifex, the maintainer of Ghostscript, rolled out a fix on September 8, in version 10.08.0 of the interpreter.
Fixes were also backported to older versions, so users should check the revision details for patch status.
WordPress administrators need to ensure, through their hosting provider, that Ghostscript has been upgraded to version 10.08.0 or later.
If using Docker, it is recommended to rebuild and redeploy with an updated, patched base image.
If unable to upgrade to a fixed Ghostscript release, it is recommended to block PDF uploads to the server or disable PDF rendering in ImageMagick.
Wordfence said it has not seen any in-the-wild exploitation of CVE-2026-39919 yet.

articles.title: Cyberattaque nationale contre les supermarchés : la situation est encore pire que prévu, une seconde cible dans la tourmente
articles.text:
Mise à jour du 13 octobre 2026 à 20h19 : Contacté par 01net, Copeland, la maison mère de Dixell, a fini par réagir. Le groupe américain reconnaît l’existence d’une faille, qui concerne selon lui une génération de contrôleurs « abandonnée et arrivée en fin de vie ». « La protection des activités de nos clients a toujours été une priorité absolue. Nous travaillons actuellement avec les clients concernés pour limiter les risques », assure Copeland, qui promet de « continuer à aider ses clients à renforcer leur cybersécurité grâce à des produits pris en charge, des logiciels à jour et les pratiques recommandées par le secteur ».
Le Leclerc de Lescure-d’Albigeois, au nord d’Albi, semblait avoir été épargné par la cyberattaque nationale à l’encontre de la grande distribution. Ce mardi 13 octobre au matin, le supermarché a pourtant été victime d’une rupture massive de la chaîne du froid, rapportent nos confrères de France 3 Régions. D’après les informations obtenues par ICI Occitanie TV, les installations du Leclerc ne sont pas fournies par Danfoss, le fabricant danois qui s’est retrouvé dans le viseur des pirates.
À lire aussi : Cyberattaque chez E.Leclerc : une fuite a exposé les données des clients
Après Danfoss, l’entreprise Dixell dans la tourmente
Les frigos sont en effet fournis par Dixell, une société d’origine italienne détenue par Copeland, un groupe américain. Dans le détail, Dixell ne fabrique pas les frigos utilisés par les magasins. L’entreprise conçoit uniquement les régulateurs qui pilotent la température des meubles réfrigérés, des chambres froides et des vitrines. Ces régulateurs contrôlent aussi des fonctions comme la ventilation et le dégivrage.
« Nous avons malheureusement été dans l’obligation ce matin de vider et jeter toute la marchandise de nos frigos », déclare un responsable du Leclerc de Lescure-d’Albigeois.
Ce n’est pas un cas isolé. Interrogé par Le Monde, Damien Deudon, frigoriste en Gironde, révèle qu’un supermarché dans la région bordelaise, équipé de contrôleurs signés Dixell, a également été piraté dans la nuit du lundi au mardi. Les hackers ont « modifié tous les paramètres de dégivrage et de régulation de température : pour les surgelés, au lieu de – 22 degrés, ils avaient mis 150 degrés », explique le frigoriste.
Une attaque plus vaste que prévu ?
L’apparition de Dixell épaissit considérablement le mystère qui entoure la cyberattaque. Pour rappel, jusqu’ici, seuls les contrôleurs Danfoss des séries AK-SM et AK-SC étaient pointés du doigt. Avec l’apparition de Dixell dans l’affaire, l’hypothèse d’une attaque coordonnée sur plusieurs fournisseurs commence à prendre forme.
En février dernier, la CISA, l’agence américaine de cybersécurité, a signalé une série de failles critiques dans les boîtiers de Dixell. Certaines des vulnérabilités permettent de contourner l’authentification, d’autres d’exécuter des commandes à distance. Le groupe Copeland a promptement publié des mises à jour pour tenir les hackers à l’écart. Néanmoins, si des magasins ont négligé d’installer la mise à jour mise à disposition, des pirates ont pu exploiter la faille pour dérégler des frigos à distance, comme ils l’ont fait avec Danfoss. Ce mardi 13 octobre, l’Anssi a d’ailleurs mis à jour son alerte de sécurité initiale et précise que les superviseurs Copeland XWEB et Dixell XWEB, utilisés pour piloter à distance les frigos, sont aussi touchés par des failles.
 MàJ ⚠️ Incident de sécurité ciblant les contrôleurs à distance des installations de réfrigération Danfoss série AK-SM, AK-SC ainsi que Copeland xweb et Dixell xweb.

articles.title: Fairbuds 2 : des écouteurs avec batterie facilement remplaçable — Frandroid
articles.text:
Après une fuite mi-septembre qui montrait le design de ses nouveaux écouteurs, Fairphone a officialisé ce mercredi 14 octobre les Fairbuds 2, dont il détaille toutes les caractéristiques.
    Pour aller plus loin
Les meilleurs écouteurs sans fil à moins de 100 euros en 2026
            
Le fabricant néerlandais renouvelle ainsi ses écouteurs intra-auriculaires. Les Fairbuds 2 abandonnent donc bien la forme ovale de leur prédécesseur au profit d’une silhouette à tige. D’après Fairphone, les écouteurs sont 37 % plus petits et le boîtier de charge 32 % plus petit que ceux des Fairbuds.
Chaque écouteur mesure 30,2 x 22,6 x 24,38 mm pour 5,8 g, contre 28,7 x 24,6 x 21 mm et environ 5 g pour la première génération. Sur le papier, l’écouteur est donc un peu plus encombrant et plus lourd, ce qui nuance la promesse de miniaturisation. Le boîtier affiche 56,5 x 45,2 x 27,7 mm et 64 g avec les écouteurs, contre 65 x 65 x 27 mm et 78 g auparavant.
De la biocellulose au lieu du titane pour le son
Sur le plan acoustique, la marque remplace le transducteur de 11 mm à revêtement titane par un modèle dynamique de 11 mm à diaphragme en biocellulose, une fibre organique. Selon le fabricant, ce composant plus léger et plus réactif apporte des aigus plus nets. Le réglage a été confié au studio rotterdamois Form Follows Frequency, qui vise à offrir des basses plus profondes et des médiums plus chauds.
Par ailleurs, les Fairbuds 2 acceptent pour la première fois le codec LDAC, développé par Sony, qui monte jusqu’à 990 kb/s pour l’audio haute résolution. Il ne fonctionne toutefois qu’avec les smartphones Android compatibles : un iPhone restera en AAC. Les codecs AAC, SBC et LC3 restent compatibles. L’application Fairbuds, revue par la marque, propose des préréglages et un égaliseur à 5 bandes.
Autonomie, réduction de bruit et connectivité
Concernant l’autonomie, Fairphone annonce jusqu’à 40 heures de lecture avec le boîtier, contre 26 heures auparavant, soit plus de 50 % de gain. Les écouteurs seuls tiennent jusqu’à 6 heures avec la réduction de bruit active et 8 heures sans, d’après la fiche technique, contre 5 et 6 heures pour la première génération. Une charge complète prend environ 2 heures. En revanche, la recharge sans fil n’est pas prévue. Les batteries comptent 45 mAh par écouteur et 500 mAh pour le boîtier, soit exactement les mêmes capacités que sur la première génération.
La réduction de bruit active hybride atténue le bruit ambiant jusqu’à 45 dB, selon Fairphone. Un mode ambiant est également proposé. Six microphones, à raison de trois par écouteur, sont chargés d’améliorer la captation de la voix lors des appels.
Du côté de la connectivité, le Bluetooth 6.0 remplace le Bluetooth 5.3. La technologie multipoint permet une connexion simultanée à deux appareils, parmi six mémorisés. La portée atteint 10 m. La certification IP54 protège les écouteurs de la poussière et des projections d’eau. Enfin, la lecture se met en pause automatiquement quand les deux écouteurs sont retirés. En revanche, aucun assistant vocal n’est intégré. Les commandes sont tactiles.
Réparabilité et matériaux responsables
La modularité reste l’argument central de la gamme audio et de la marque en général, notamment pour ses smartphones. Les Fairbuds 2 se démontent sans colle et comptent, comme la première génération, sept composants remplaçables par l’utilisateur, dont les batteries des écouteurs et celle du boîtier. Ce n’est pas le cas des AirPods 5, qui ont malgré tout fait des progrès dans ce domaine.
Les Fairbuds 2 profitent d’une garantie de trois ans. Le constructeur rappelle que les batteries d’écouteurs classiques se dégradent en 18 à 24 mois et que moins de 15 % des petits appareils électroniques sont recyclés ou réutilisés. Fairphone avance aussi le chiffre d’environ 40 000 tonnes d’écouteurs jetés chaque année.
Sur le plan des matériaux, la marque revendique environ 49 % de matériaux équitables et recyclés, contre 70 % annoncés pour la première génération. Les terres rares des aimants et l’étain de la pâte à souder sont recyclés à 100 %. L’or, le cobalt, le cuivre et l’argent sont couverts par des crédits de matières équitables. Les plastiques et le silicone au contact de la peau sont certifiés sans PFAS par SGS. L’assemblage utilise de l’énergie renouvelable.
Disponibilité et prix des écouteurs Fairphone Fairbuds 2
Les Fairbuds 2 sont disponibles dès ce mercredi 14 octobre sur Fairphone.com ainsi que chez certains revendeurs et opérateurs. Deux coloris sont proposés : Noir Horizon et Vert Forest pour un prix de 119 euros.

articles.title: Google Antigravity SDK Adds Local Model Support for Greater Token Efficiency and Code Privacy
articles.text:
Google has introduced support for local models in the Antigravity SDK, enabling developers to build and execute agentic workflows directly on their own machines, while retaining the flexibility to mix in cloud-based models for higher-level tasks. This approach gives developers greater control over data privacy, inference costs, network dependencies, and computational workload distribution.
One of the most compelling capabilities of the Antigravity SDK is hybrid agent orchestration, which adapts Google's proposed Architect-Builder pattern to a mixed cloud-local compute environment.
According to the Architect-Builder pattern, one primary, high-context AI agent, the architect, holds the macro-level system view, including dependencies, architectural guardrails, and detailed specifications or implementation plans. Once the architect has defined a plan, several parallel, multiple specialized AI agents, the builders, work independently in isolated environments to execute discrete, narrow tasks mapped out by the specification.
Google says that the Antigravity SDK enables the architect to operate in the cloud, devising a strategy and breaking the task into smaller units using filenames and task descriptions, without requiring access to the source code itself. The builders, instead, run locally and perform tasks such as reproducing security vulnerabilities, proposing code fixes, reviewing candidate patches, and running regression tests. Additional specialized local agents can validate proposed changes against the provided test suites, keeping the code-intensive stages of the workflow on-device.
In a demonstration involving the auditing and patching ot three vulnerable Python modules, Google reports that only 95 out of approximately 3400 tokens were used on the cloud for planning, while the remaining 97.2% were spent locally. Google also states that no source code was uploaded to the cloud.
The initial implementation focuses on running Gemma 4 26B A4B through Google's LiteRT technology. However, developers are not limited to LiteRT exclusively, as the Antigravity SDK also supports OpenAI-compatible local inference servers through LocalOpenAIAgentConfig, including Ollama, LM Studio, and vLLM.
Commenting on the announcement, Reddit user ambassadortim highlighted that "companies can have more control over their AI model and when to change or at least have more control over that". In a separate discussion, FollowingTop3534 questioned whether the cloud-token share metrics tells the whole story:
I'd benchmark patch acceptance, wall time, and energy alongside the cloud-token share. '97.2% of tokens ran locally' is interesting, but it doesn't tell you whether the run was faster or cheaper on your hardware, and the recommended 24GB+ VRAM or unified memory is a real gate.
As a final note from the community, user Latter_Crazy expressed enthusiasmfor the new capabilities:
it can do things I could not do before with the cloud rules. Cost, speed, quality are all going up and this is just the start. Highly recommend looking into this.
The Antigravity SDK should not be confused with the Antigravity IDE, which is an IDE powered by the Antigravity SDK. They share the same underlying agent infrastructure, but serve different purposes, with the SDK letting you build your own AI agents programmatically rather than simply using them for coding tasks.

articles.title: À 18 ans, il gagne déjà sa vie en revendant des LEGO sur eBay, son activité a généré plus de 350 000 € en un an pour s'acheter son premier appartement
articles.text:
À 18 ans, il gagne déjà sa vie en revendant des LEGO sur eBay, son activité a généré plus de 350 000 € en un an pour s'acheter son premier appartement
Avec des millions de passionnés dans le monde, les Lego sont une vraie manne financière. Et à 18 ans à peine, Jamie Bell, qui vit au sud de Londres, a déjà généré un peu plus de 354 000 € de chiffre d’affaires par an dans la revente de lots sur eBay. Pour le bénéfice, c’est près de 59 000 € quand on retire l’achat du stock et les autres frais.
Et pas besoin d’avoir une collection rare. À 13 ans, Jamie Bell a d’abord commencé par vendre ses jouets. Puis à 14 ans, il achète son premier set Lego et revend les pièces séparément pour environ deux fois son prix d’achat. La stratégie est toute trouvée : écouler chaque figurine à l’unité sur sa page eBay, disponible à cette adresse.
Sur eBay, ses pièces LEGO s'écoulent en masse
C’est à 15 ans à peine que Jamie Bell a déjà acheté des stocks en masse pour les revendre à des collectionneurs et aux professionnels de la revente. "J’étais leur fournisseur", résume le jeune homme. Mais à 16 ans, son activité marche tellement qu’il doit faire appel à un expert-comptable.
Son activité a donc rapidement pris de l’ampleur autour de la ferveur des acheteurs de Lego. Lors de la première année, le jeune homme réalise environ 118 000 € de chiffre d’affaires puis 354 000 € l’année suivante, soit un triplement en un an. Bref, une activité qui rapporte.
Jamie Bell a donc trouvé un créneau de niche entre les gros vendeurs et les petits. Chaque mois, il écoule près de 100 kilos de Lego et sa boutique eBay affiche 2 900 ventes conclues et 100 % d’évaluations positives. Parmi les ventes de Jamie Bell, 95 kilos de figurines Lego Star Wars mis en vente au prix de départ de 1 € cette année.
Puis après 65 offres, le lot est parti à environ 26 500 €. Mais il ne s’agit pas de sa meilleure opération puisque le jeune homme confie que le lot lui a coûté très cher. Pour ses grosses ventes, on trouve notamment une enchère qui s’est terminée à environ 5 270 € ou encore la vente de deux figurines Lego Batman pour près de 890 €.
Selon Jamie Bell, environ 40 % de ses clients sont de gros collectionneurs avec un budget conséquent. Et parmi ces 40 %, il y en a 60 % qui achètent pour les revendre à l’unité. Jamie Bell gère lui-même l’activité, son père l’aide à expédier les colis et pour une partie de l’administratif. Quant au stock, il est stocké chez ses parents dans de grandes boîtes en carton.
Jamie Bell ne compte pas continuer dans la vente de Lego. Son avenir, il le voit à l’université, en train d’étudier l’histoire pour avoir une carrière bien plus stable. Une grande partie de ses revenus part dans son compte épargne avec comme objectif d’acheter un premier appartement.

articles.title: GTA 6 is reportedly coming to PC in Q1 2027, just months after consoles
articles.text:
Crystal ball: Rockstar has always made PC players wait for its big releases, sometimes for a year or two. If a new report proves accurate, however, Grand Theft Auto VI could break that pattern. The reason may have less to do with goodwill toward PC gamers and more to do with where GTA's online future is likely to be built.
Rockstar plans to release the PC version of Grand Theft Auto VI as soon as Q1 2027, according to a GamesBeat report citing four industry sources. Rockstar has not responded to requests for comment, and there's no official announcement yet either.
Meanwhile, the long-awaited console version of GTA VI remains on track for November 19 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series. A Q1 2027 PC launch would mean a gap of just a few months.
That would be a sharp break from Rockstar's track record: GTA V launched on consoles in September 2013 and did not reach PC until April 2015, some 19 months later. In the case of Red Dead Redemption 2, the game arrived on consoles in October 2018 and on PC in November 2019.
This new report contradicts the company's public messaging, at least on the surface. In May, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick told Bloomberg that Rockstar "always starts on console" because it needs to serve its core audience first. In the same interview, he acknowledged that PC can account for 45% to 50% of sales on some titles.
Leaked analytics data suggests why Take-Two sees consoles as the core. The data was dumped by ShinyHunters after Rockstar ignored a ransom demand. According to those figures, PC accounted for 11% of GTA Online's weekly active users but only 3% of its bookings, generating around $0.30 per user per week. PS5 users generated roughly $1.29 per user per week.
The wildcard: Roleplay servers live on PC
So why rush a port for the platform that spends the least? A possible answer is roleplay. In 2023, Rockstar acquired FiveM, the mod framework that powers GTA V's huge roleplay server scene, and it runs entirely on PC. Rockstar has also signaled plans for user-generated content tools in GTA VI.
The rumor would tie in nicely with GTA VI's still-unannounced online mode. Twitch CEO Dan Clancy recently told Bloomberg that Rockstar's multiplayer component will launch next year. A PC release in early 2027 would put the platform in place before GTA Online's successor goes live, rather than leaving PC players to join a year or more later.
But preparing for a PC release will take extra time, unless Rockstar already has it ready internally and is just using the remaining months to polish and troubleshoot, while finalizing performance targets, system requirements, upscaling support, and how far the PC version might push visuals beyond consoles.
Still, for those who have been around long enough, shipping mere months after such a big release sounds too optimistic. Rockstar has already delayed GTA VI twice, from 2025 to May 2026 and then to November 19. The game's budget is rumored to exceed $2 billion, and the PC version will still need to meet the same quality bar as the console release.

articles.title: Video | Así es el exoesqueleto robótico que permite “caminar” a personas con paraplejia
articles.text:
Jessica Tawil volvió a dar sus primeros pasos en más de una década con la ayuda de un exoesqueleto portátil. (Tomado de Instagram)
Jessica Tawil dio sus primeros pasos en más de una década con un exoesqueleto portátil, luego de que un accidente automovilístico ocurrido en Nueva Jersey, Estados Unidos, en noviembre de 2014 le provocara una lesión medular y la dejara paralizada de la parte inferior del cuerpo.
El video superó las 200 millones de reproducciones en Instagram, donde la joven de 27 años reúne más de 800 mil seguidores. La publicación acumuló más de 8 millones de me gusta y 140.000 comentarios.
Tawil tenía 16 años cuando sufrió el accidente. Desde entonces usa una silla de ruedas a diario y fue diagnosticada como parapléjica T6, una condición que le impide mover las piernas y la parte inferior de su cuerpo.
Aunque considera que posiblemente no vuelva a caminar de forma natural, el dispositivo le permitió ponerse de pie y avanzar. Al incorporarse, reaccionó con incredulidad: “Oh, Dios mío... está bien, está bien, está bien”.
Cómo es la tecnología detrás del exoesqueleto
Los exoesqueletos son estructuras que se colocan sobre el cuerpo y utilizan energía para asistir el movimiento de personas con parálisis. Suelen fabricarse con metal y fibra de carbono, e incorporan sensores que registran los desplazamientos del usuario.
En quienes no pueden mover las piernas, estos sistemas interpretan señales de la parte superior del cuerpo. Inclinarse hacia adelante o desplazar las caderas puede activar el inicio de un paso.
Algunos modelos, incluido el que utilizó Tawil, cuentan con controles situados en las muñecas para dirigir el movimiento. Otros incorporan botones desde los que el usuario puede ordenar cada acción.
La tecnología fue desarrollada durante años por científicos e ingenieros con el objetivo de ampliar la movilidad de personas con paraplejia. Sumado a permitirles caminar con asistencia, los investigadores han asociado su uso con efectos físicos y psicológicos.
Qué beneficios de salud traen los exoesqueletos
Un estudio publicado en 2022 en el Journal of Personalized Medicine señaló que caminar con un exoesqueleto puede fortalecer músculos afectados, mejorar la velocidad y la eficiencia de la marcha, y actuar sobre consecuencias secundarias de una lesión medular.
Los autores incluyeron entre esos posibles efectos la espasticidad, la densidad ósea, la masa corporal magra, el tono muscular, el dolor y cambios en las funciones cardiovasculares, de la vejiga y del intestino. A su vez, indicaron que se registraron mejoras en el estado de ánimo, la salud mental y la calidad de vida.
Cómo le fue a la creadora de contenido probando el exoesqueleto
En el video se observa el procedimiento mediante el cual la máquina eleva a la joven desde una banqueta hasta la postura erguida. Durante la sesión, dos especialistas permanecieron a su lado para supervisar la prueba e impartir instrucciones sobre la operación de los mandos del dispositivo.
A lo largo del ensayo, los técnicos explicaron a Tawil la manera de dirigir los controles para realizar giros a la izquierda y avanzar en línea recta por el recinto. El exoesqueleto sostiene el torso y las extremidades inferiores mediante correas y soportes rígidos, permitiendo el movimiento asistido de las piernas.
Hacia el final de la prueba, la creadora de contenido se desplazó hacia un espejo ubicado frente a los ventanales del establecimiento para observar la posición erguida con la estructura robótica colocada.
Asimismo, este tipo de tecnología médica basada en robótica, se utiliza en procesos de rehabilitación e investigación para proporcionar soporte físico y movilidad asistida a pacientes con parálisis o afectaciones en la columna vertebral.
Actualmente, el desarrollo de estos sistemas tecnológicos continúa en fase de evaluación clínica, con el objetivo de mejorar la autonomía funcional de los usuarios y analizar la viabilidad de su integración progresiva en espacios de uso personal y cotidiano.

articles.title: Apple lança HomeView, tela inteligente para controlar a casa • Tecnoblog
articles.text:
Apple lança HomeView, tela inteligente para controlar a casa
Dispositivo de 7 polegadas reúne FaceTime, música e automação residencial. Empresa também apresentou acessórios para casa conectada em parceria com a LG.
A Apple apresentou nesta terça-feira (13/10) uma nova linha de produtos para a casa, com destaque para o HomeView, dispositivo com tela Liquid Retina de 7 polegadas que deve rivalizar com o Echo Show com Alexa, da Amazon. O dispositivo reúne funções que hoje dependem de diferentes aparelhos e aplicativos e começa a ser vendido em 13 de novembro, pelo preço de US$ 299 (cerca de R$ 1.500, em conversão direta). O valor no Brasil ainda não foi divulgado.
O HomeView reconhece até seis pessoas pelo rosto e adapta a interface a cada usuário. A integração com a Siri também permite acessar funções da casa conectada por comandos de voz.
Ele será comercializado nas cores prata, azul, rosa e cinza espacial, e pode ficar sobre uma mesa ou ser instalado na parede com suportes específicos. Segundo a Apple, o Apple HomeView permite acessar chamadas pelo FaceTime, reproduzir músicas, conferir informações pessoais e controlar acessórios inteligentes.
Welcome HomeView https://t.co/mXYPyXOZ1U
— John Ternus (@johnternus) October 13, 2026
A Apple também apresentou a Home Collection, uma linha de acessórios para casas inteligentes desenvolvida com a LG Electronics e a Schneider Electric. O conjunto inclui câmeras internas e externas, campainha com vídeo, fechadura inteligente, termostato e sensores de temperatura.
As câmeras gravam vídeos em resolução de até 2,5K e identificam pessoas, animais, veículos e encomendas. A fechadura da LG, por sua vez, usa tecnologia Ultra Wideband para destrancar a porta automaticamente quando uma pessoa com um iPhone ou Apple Watch compatível se aproxima.
Os dispositivos podem ser gerenciados pelo aplicativo Casa, e a configuração de alguns deles pode ser feita por aproximação do iPhone. Os primeiros acessórios chegam ao mercado em dezembro, enquanto alguns modelos estão previstos para o início de 2027.
O Apple TV 4K também foi renovado. O aparelho passa a usar o chip A19 e recebe uma versão atualizada da Siri com inteligência artificial. A assistente permite procurar filmes e séries por meio de conversas, responder a perguntas sobre o conteúdo em reprodução e usar informações pessoais para oferecer recomendações.
O controle remoto Siri Remote também ganhou integração com o Buscar, recurso que ajuda a localizar o acessório quando ele desaparece entre as almofadas do sofá.
De acordo com a Apple, o novo modelo oferece desempenho até 50% superior na CPU e duas vezes mais rápido na GPU em comparação com a geração anterior. O produto também deve chegar ao mercado em 13 de novembro, por R$ 3.599. Além disso, a empresa renovou a linha HomePod mini, que não recebia uma nova geração há seis anos.

articles.title: Homebrew App Brings Xbox Cloud Gaming to Jailbroken PS5s
articles.text:
Tuesday, October 13th 2026
Homebrew App Brings Xbox Cloud Gaming to Jailbroken PS5s
Jailbroken PS5 owners can now stream Xbox games on Sony's console. Developer RafaelNGP has released PSBox Cloud Gaming on GitHub, an unofficial Xbox Cloud Gaming client that runs natively on homebrew-enabled PS5s through a loader such as ShadowMountPlus. Sign-in works through a code entered at microsoft.com/link, and a Game Pass Ultimate subscription is still required. The DualSense acts as an Xbox controller, rumble included, and the latest build even adds voice chat through the DualSense mic. Streams run at 1080p60 by default, with 720p for slower connections and an experimental 1440p mode where Microsoft offers it. Interestingly, the app can also use the PS5's GPU to upscale the stream to 4K, with a choice between AMD FSR 1 and the Anime4K upscaler.
The project is moving fast, too. Version 0.5.0, which brought the 4K upscaling, landed on October 8, and version 0.9.5 followed just two days later, picking up Remote Play to your own Xbox along the way. Video is H.264 decoded on the CPU, so there's no HDR for now, and bitrate sits at around 10 to 12 Mbps at 1080p. Some early testers reportedly ran into macroblocking, pink artifacts, and DualSense vibration issues. It's the latest in a busy stretch for PS5 homebrew, following emulators that run Nintendo Switch games, load PS2 discs, and even get Halo 2 running on the console. Of course, Microsoft could change or block the services the client relies on at any time, something the developer notes in the project's own README notes.
Sources:
				PSBox (GitHub), 				RafaelNGP on Reddit, 				via Tom's Hardware

articles.title: SpaceX bride Starlink à 160 km/h en Ukraine, quatre jours après qu'Elon Musk a jugé que « Zelensky est allé trop loin »
articles.text:
Le jeu trouble de Washington à l’égard de Kiev se poursuit. Alors que l’armée ukrainienne continue de faire son possible pour résister à l’invasion russe et, un jour, la repousser hors de ses frontières, un nouveau coup est venu par derrière, de l’allié américain. Dans la nuit du mardi 13 au mercredi 14 octobre, la connectivité à Starlink a été bridée.
C’est Serhii Beskrestnov, conseiller de Volodymyr Zelensky pour les technologies de défense et plus connu sous l’indicatif Flash, qui l’a dit sur son compte Telegram : « Nos forces de défense n’ont pas été prévenues de cette restriction, et cela a fait échouer plusieurs missions ». Le bridage se déclenche dès que les terminaux dépassent les 160 km/h.
Il n’est pas le seul à le dire : Serhii Sternenko, militant et conseiller du ministre ukrainien de la Défense Mykhailo Fedorov de janvier à juillet 2026, l’a signalé sur X : « Le fonctionnement des terminaux Starlink a été restreint », écrit-il, en précisant que « les terminaux de communication par satellite classiques [qui ne bougent pas à ces hautes vitesses, NDLR] fonctionnent pour l’instant normalement ».
La limite touche le « pack militaire » de StarShield, la version de Starlink que SpaceX vend aux gouvernements et aux armées, fait remarquer Flash. Sur une ligne de front, peu de véhicules roulent aussi vite. En revanche, un drone à longue portée, lui, dépasse cette vitesse sans difficulté. Or, dans le conflit russo-ukrainien, Kiev compte beaucoup sur ces engins.
Un bridage qui ne peut toucher que l’Ukraine
Ce n’est pas la première fois que SpaceX bride des terminaux selon leur vitesse de déplacement. Fin janvier 2026, l’entreprise américaine avait pris des contre-mesures de ce type, mais elle visait alors les drones russes équipés de Starlink, et à la demande du ministère ukrainien de la Défense, préoccupé par l’usage pirate de Starlink par Moscou.
Pour régler le problème, SpaceX, la maison mère de Starlink, a mis en place un système de liste blanche début février. Depuis cette date, seuls les terminaux enregistrés par l’Ukraine fonctionnent, et les troupes russes qui s’en servaient ont perdu l’accès. Cette capacité perdue, côté russe, a même offert une opportunité de contre-attaque ukrainienne.
Sur le papier, avec cette liste blanche, les seuls terminaux militaires encore actifs dans le pays sont ukrainiens. La nouvelle limite ne peut donc gêner qu’eux.
Starlink ne fonctionne pas au-dessus du territoire russe, a par ailleurs rappelé Yaroslav Trofimov, correspondant en chef pour l’international du Wall Street Journal. Une coupure de Starlink en Ukraine n’empêcherait donc pas les frappes de Kiev contre l’industrie pétrolière russe, car l’armée ukrainienne dispose d’autres moyens de guidage et de ciblage.
« Deal » sur le pétrole, cessez-le-feu énergétique et pression de Washington
Pour Flash, la décision « ne peut pas être une coïncidence » et elle est liée à « la situation politique actuelle ». Même analyse chez Serhii Sternenko sur X, qui écrit « qu’il est probable que la société SpaceX ait pris ces mesures à la demande de l’administration Trump ». Quitte à ce que cela entraîne l’échec de plusieurs missions en cours.
Le contexte donne un éclairage à la situation : en octobre, Donald Trump a mis sur le dos de la guerre russo-ukrainienne les récentes envolées du prix du carburant, passant sous silence sa propre aventure militaire en Iran et la paralysie du détroit d’Ormuz. Et il a aussi reproché à Kiev de ne pas montrer assez d’allant pour faire la paix avec Moscou.
Alors que Donald Trump a annoncé le 9 octobre un accord avec le Kremlin pour alimenter les marchés américain et mondial en diesel russe (plus de 4,8 millions de tonnes promises, une première depuis l’interdiction américaine de 2022), le locataire de la Maison-Blanche s’agace des frappes répétées et ciblées de l’Ukraine sur les installations pétrolières et gazières russes. Des tirs menés en riposte aux attaques russes contre l’infrastructure énergétique d’Ukraine.
Kiev a répété être disposée à ne plus cibler ces centres si Moscou cesse au même moment ses attaques sur ses propres installations énergétiques. À ce stade, cependant, Moscou n’a montré aucune inclination à réorienter ses tirs sur d’autres cibles. Kiev ne se sent donc pas liée par l’accord entre Washington et Moscou, et poursuit ses opérations.
Cette situation confuse, accentuée par une annonce américaine de cessez-le-feu énergétique dont l’Ukraine a indiqué tout ignorer et que la Russie a refusé de commenter, a fait monter les tensions. Donald Trump a reproché à son homologue Volodymyr Zelensky de ne pas en faire assez et jugé aussi que l’Ukraine devrait élire un nouveau président.
Quatre jours après les piques d’Elon Musk
C’est ici qu’intervient Elon Musk, le patron de SpaceX. L’intéressé, qui est très proche de Donald Trump, a glissé sur X l’avis selon lequel « Zelensky est allé trop loin ». Peu après, il a enfoncé le clou en jugeant qu’il était temps pour l’Ukraine de changer de dirigeant. Ces propos, publiés les 10 et 11 octobre, ont précédé de quelques jours seulement le bridage de Starlink.
D’ailleurs, Serhii Sternenko avance même que SpaceX a agi à la demande de l’administration Trump. Cela étant, à ce stade, personne n’a formellement établi qu’une telle demande existe, ni que la décision a un motif politique. L’imminence des élections de mi-mandat aux États-Unis, le 3 novembre, est aussi de nature à agiter la Maison-Blanche, car Donald Trump joue gros.
Quelques jours plus tôt, Flash se voulait pourtant rassurant. Il écrivait qu’Elon Musk est « avant tout un homme d’affaires » et que l’Ukraine rapporte trop d’argent à SpaceX (via le financement de pays alliés) pour qu’on y coupe Starlink. Il n’excluait pas, en revanche, d’« autres scénarios inattendus », comme une ouverture de Starlink à la Russie sur son propre territoire.
